sa: स्त्रजश्च सर्वरत्नानि प्रिया याश्च वराङ्गना॥ ऐश्वर्यं च विशालायां पृथिव्यामपि दुर्लभम्। पितरं मातरं चैव सम्मान्याभिप्रसाद्य च॥ अनुप्रव्रजितो रामं सुमित्रा येन सुप्रजाः। आनुकूल्येन धर्मात्मा त्यक्त्वा सुखमनुत्तमम्॥ अनुगच्छति काकुत्स्थं भ्रातरं पालयन् वने। सिंहस्कन्धो महाबाहुर्मनस्वी प्रियदर्शनः॥ पितृवद् वर्तते रामे मातृवन्मां समाचरत्। ह्रियमाणां तदा वीरो न तु मां वेद लक्ष्मणः॥ वृद्धोपसेवी लक्ष्मीवाशक्तो न बहुभाषिता। राजपुत्रप्रियश्रेष्ठः सदृशः श्वशुरस्य मे॥ मत्तः प्रियतरो नित्यं भ्राता रामस्य लक्
en: Do you on my behalf, and on account of my words, enquire after the welfare of him, who, renouncing wreaths and gems of all kinds, and beloved damsels possessed of transcendent beauty, and wealth such as is difficult to obtain on this spacious earth; and who, honouring and bowing to his father and mother, followed Rāma, in whom Sumitrā has an excellent son, of that righteous one, who, espousing the cause of his brother, renouncing choice happiness, follow his brother to the forest, ministering to him; who is lion-shouldered, long-armed, intelligent, and of a prepossessing presence; who bear himself towards Rāma as if he were his sire, and towards me, as if I were his mother; of that heroic Laks maņa who did not know when I was ravished away-the servant of the elders, crowned with auspicious

sa: तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा हरिगणाशरवृष्टिभिरर्दितान्। अङ्गदं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा भ्रातृजं प्लवगेश्वरः॥ अभिदुद्राव सुग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णात्मजं रणे। शैलसानुचरं नागं वेगवानिव केसरी॥
en: Seeing those monkeys sore distressed by the shafts, the king of the monkeys, Sugrīva, in that conflict taking his brother's son on his back, rushed against the son of Kumbhakarna, even as a powerful lion rush at an elephant ranging on the slopes of a mountain.

sa: एते हि फुल्लनयनास्त्रासादागतसाध्वसाः। कर्णे कर्णे प्रकथिता हरयो हरिसत्तम॥
en: O best of monkeys, these with distended eyes, come under the governance of terror, are, stricken with panic, whispering into each other's ears.

sa: असृजद्भगवान्पक्षौ द्वावेव हि पितामहः। सुराणामसुराणां च धर्माधर्मों तदाश्रयौ॥
en: That possessor of the six attributes, the Greatfather, has appointed two courses, (respectively) for the Asuras and the celestials, having for their eousness.

sa: हरियुक्तं सहस्राक्षो रथमिन्द्र इवानघः। प्रययौ रथमास्थाय रामो नगरमुत्तमम्॥
en: Like to the thousand-eyed Indra in his car, drawn by horses the blameless Rāma; seated in his car, proceeded towards the excellent city.

sa: अश्मसारमिदं नूनमथवाप्यजरामरम्। हृदयं मम येनेदं न दुःखेन विशीर्यते॥
en: Forsooth my my life is is made of stone, imperishable and immortal since it is not riven asunder even by this mighty grief.

sa: ततो धाराशताकीर्णं शारदाभ्रनिभं तदा। नित्यप्रहृष्टं ददृशे वरुणस्य गृहोत्तमम्॥
en: Then he beheld Varuna's splendid mansion, streaming with hundreds of torrents, resembling a mass of autumnal clouds, and always wearing a delightful aspect.

sa: मत्कार्मुकनिसृष्टेन शरवर्षेण सागर। परं तीरं गमिष्यन्ति पद्भिरेव प्लवङ्गमाः॥
en: O Ocean, in consequence of the arrowy shower discharged from my bow, the monkeys shall go over to the further shore on foot.

sa: दुन्दुभिस्वननिर्घोषः स्निग्धवर्णः प्रतापवान्। समश्च सुविभक्ताङ्गो वर्णं श्यामं समाश्रितः॥
en: He has the voice of a bugle, is of a cool hue and highly powerful, has equally proportioned limbs and a green colour.

sa: कुशध्वजो नाम पिता ब्रह्मर्षिरमितप्रभः। बृहस्पतिसुतः श्रीमान्बुद्ध्या तुल्यो बृहस्पतेः।।।।।
en: My sire is named Kušadhvaja a Brahmarși of immeasurable energy, son to Bệhaspati, endowed with grace, and like to Bphaspati himself in intelligence.

sa: तस्य सानुषु कूजन्ति नानाद्विजगणास्तथा। स्नात्वा पीत्वोदकान्यत्र जलेक्रीडन्ति वानराः॥
en: Various birds set up their musical choir on the summit of that mount. And bathing and drinking, these monkeys sported in the water.

sa: स कक्षमिव विस्तीर्णं शुष्कन्धनमिवाकुलम्। वातेनाग्निरिवादीप्तो यक्षसैन्यं ददाह तत्.।१५।।
en: And as a flaming fire burn up an extensive sward of grass stocked with dry fire-wood, he began to consume that Yakşa army.

sa: तमिच्छन्प्रथमं योद्धं लक्ष्मणो निशितैः शरैः। मुमोच धनुरायम्य शरानग्निशिखोपमान्॥
en: And desiring to fight with him first Lakşmana setting sharp arrows on his bow, discharged shafts at him resembling the flame of fire.

sa: अहं द्विजिह्वः संहादी कुम्भकर्णो वितर्दनाः। पञ्च रामवधायैते निर्यान्तीत्यवघोषय॥
en: Do you proclaim it about that I and Dvijihva and Samhrādī, and Kumbhakarņa and Vitardanathese five-are marching for compassing the destruction of Rāma.

sa: कृत्रिमा दीर्घिकां चापि पूर्णां शीतेन वारिणा। मणिप्रवरसोपानां मुक्तासिकतशोभिताम्॥
en: He saw a big artificial pond full of cool water having stairs crusted with excellent jewels and its sandy banks filled with pearls.

sa: एतदेव समागम्य यत्नं कर्तुमिहार्हथ ॥ राक्षसाश्चापि तिष्ठन्तु चर्यागोपुरमूर्धसु।
en: Taking note of this, you should strive (to the uttermost.) And let the Räkşasas be posted at the gateways, highways, and the walls.

sa: श्रोणिसूत्रेण महता मेचकेन व्यराजत। अमृतोत्पादने नद्धो भुजंगेनेव मन्दरः॥
en: With his great dark girdle he seemed like the Mandara fastened by the serpent on the occasion of the churning of the sea.

sa: विसृज्य तं काशिपति त्रिशतं पृथिवीपतीन्॥ प्रहसन्राघवो वाक्यमुवाच मधुराक्षरम्।
en: Having bade adieu to the king of Kasi, Rama, with a smiling countenance and sweet accents, said to the three hundred assembled kings.

sa: सृष्टान्विविदमैन्दाभ्यां दुमानुत्पाट्य वीर्यवान्। बभञ्ज गदया मध्ये शोणिताक्षः प्रतापवान्॥
en: The powerful Sonitaksa, endowed with prowess, with his mace severed in the middle the trees which Dvivida and Mainda had uprooted and discharged.

sa: ते ज्वलन्तो महावेगास्तेजसा सायकोत्तमाः। प्रविशन्ति समुद्रस्य जलं वित्रस्तपन्नगम्॥
en: Thereat, flaming up, those vehement choice shafts surcharged with energy, enter into the waters of the sea, with its serpents afflicted with fear.

sa: तच्चास्य बलमादास्ये बलेन महता वृतः। ज्योतिषामिव सर्वेषां प्रभामुद्यन्दिवाकरः॥
en: When, surrounded by a mighty host, shall I confound his ranks, even as the Sun arising, (vanquish) the light of the stellar spheres?

sa: ततो विस्मयमापन्ना हरयो ददृशुः स्थिताः। भ्रान्तोर्मिजालसंनादं प्रलोलमिव सागरम्॥
en: There upon, overwhelmed with surprise, those monkeys, stationed there, espied the main brimming with rolling waters and moving as if (off its place).

sa: आदित्यं पातयिष्यामि सनक्षत्रं महीतले॥ शतक्रतुं वधिष्यामि पास्यामि वरुणालयम्।
en: I shall bring down the very welkin garnished with stars. And I shall slay Satakratu and drink up the abode itself of Varuna.

sa: तेषां सुतुमुलं युद्धं संजज्ञे कपिरक्षसाम्। अन्योन्यं पादपैोरैनिघ्नतां शूलमुद्गरैः॥
en: Then there took place a terrific conflict between the monkeys and the Rākşasas, charging each other with fearful trees, and darts, and maces.

sa: कलशीमपविद्ध्यान्या प्रसुप्ता भाति भामिनी। वसन्ते पुष्पशबला मालेव परिमार्जिता॥
en: Another woman, intoxicated by wine, was discovered asleep, with her water-vessel upset; and, in consequence, appearing like a wellwashed variegated wreath in spring.

sa: तं गजैश्च तुरंगैश्च स्यन्दनैश्चाम्बुदस्वनैः। अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानो रथिनो रथिनां वरम्॥
en: And high-souled mighty warriors followed that foremost of heroes with elephant and steeds and chariots sending out rattle resembling the rumbling of thunder.

sa: व्याघ्रो मृगमिवादाय मृगराडिव कुञ्जरम्। ररास हैहयो राजा हर्षादम्बुदवन्मुहुः॥
en: And the king emitted leonine roars again and again as a tiger joyous roars like a cloud, holding a deer under his grasp.

sa: वसेत्सह सपत्नेन क्रुद्धनाशीविषेण च। न तु मित्रप्रवादेन संवसेच्छत्रुसेविना॥
en: It is better to live with open enemies or enraged serpents than with those who pass for friends but are in reality foes.

sa: कथं चाल्पशरीरस्त्वं मामितो नेतुमिच्छसि। सकाशं मानवेन्द्रस्य भर्तुर्मे प्लवगर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, little-bodied as you are, how do you desire, to take me hence to my husband the lord of men?

sa: तत्रोपधार्य मायानां शतमेकं समाप्तवान्। सलिलेन्द्रपुरान्वेषी भ्रमति स्म रसातलम्॥
en: Having learnt there a hundred sorts of illusion, he directed his course to Rasātala, searching for the city of the lord of waters.

sa: एवमुक्तो महातेजा धृतिमानुरुविक्रमः। उवाच त्रिदशश्रेष्ठं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: Being thus addressed, the highly effulgent and intelligent Rāma, of unmitigated prowess-the foremost of the pious, spoke to that best of celestials saying.

sa: ततो महाशक्तिशतैः पात्यमानैर्महोरसि । नाशक्नोत्प्रतिकर्तुं स राक्षसः स्वल्पपीडितः॥
en: Again at his spacious breast, that Raksasa who had undergone slender injury, could not resist, (Yama's arms) with hundreds of mighty darts hurled.

sa: श्रेयोऽभियुक्तं धयं च शृणु पुत्र वचो मम॥ वरप्रदानसंमूढो मान्यामान्यं सुदुर्मतिः। न वेत्ति मम शापाच्च प्रकृति दारुणां गतः॥
en: Do you listen to my words fraught with religion and profit. Of a wicked heart, you, with your understanding spoilt in consequence of the granting of the boon, can not distinguish between those deserving honour and those not; and, further, through my curse, you have come by fierce nature.

sa: क्रियतामविरोधश्च राघवेणेति यन्मया॥ उच्यमानं न गृह्णासि तस्येयं व्युष्टिरागता।
en: I prevented you from creating enmity with Rāghava but you did not pay heed to my words and this is the result (thereof).

sa: उभौ हि परमेष्वासावुभौ युद्धविशारदौ। उभावस्त्रविदां मुख्यावुभौ युद्धे विचेरतुः॥
en: Both of them were proficient in archery, skilled in the art of conflict and foremost of those conversant with the use of weapons.

sa: तेषामन्योन्यमासाद्य संग्रामः सुमहानभूत्। बहूनामश्मवृष्टिं च शरवर्ष च वर्षताम्॥
en: And each party approaching the other, great was the encounter that took place. And innumerable (monkeys and Rākṣasas) kept showering rocks and arrows.

sa: अद्यैव चित्रकूटस्य काननं निशितैः शरैः॥ छिन्दञ्छत्रुशरीराणि करिष्ये शोणितोक्षितम्।
en: To day with sharpened shafts will I cut the bodies of the hostile hosts and drench the woods of Citrakuta with their blood.

sa: रक्षितं सुमहद् राज्यमहमेकस्तु नोत्सहे। पौरजानपदांश्चापि रक्तान् रञ्जयितुं तदा॥
en: I do not venture to govern this vast kingdom alone, or please the citizens and the inhabitants of the provinces attached to you.

sa: नहि मां त्वत्समीपस्थामपि शक्रोऽपि राघव। सुराणामीश्वरः शक्तः प्रधर्षयितुमोजसा॥
en: If I live by you, O Rāghava, Sakra, the lord of celestials, shall not be able with his mighty power to defeat me.

sa: उत्तिष्ठ मूढे किं शेषे भयं त्वामभिवर्तते। उपप्लुतमघौघेन नात्मानमवबुध्यसे॥
en: Up, you senseless one! What for are you down? A great danger approaches you. You understand not that a mighty grief overflow you.

sa: तेन वित्रासिता नागाः करेणुपरिवारिताः। आवासयन्तो गन्धेन जग्मुरन्यद्वनं ततः॥
en: And frightened by the uproar, elephants accompanied by female ones, perfuming all sides (by the fragrance of temporal juice), went to another forest.

sa: हिरण्यगर्भो मैनाको निशम्य लवणाम्भसः। उत्पपात जलात् तूर्णं महादुमलतावृतः॥
en: Hearing the speech of the Ocean, the golden mountain Maināka, covered with tall trees and creepers, rose up instantly from his watery bed.

sa: शिबिकाभिश्च यानैश्च यथार्ह तस्य योषितः। नगरान्निर्ययुस्तत्र वृद्धैः परिवृतास्तथा॥ प्रसव्यं चापि तं चक्रुर्ऋत्विजोऽग्निचितं नृपम्। स्त्रियश्च शोकसंतप्ता: कौसल्याप्रमुखास्तदा॥
en: By means of litters and other conveyances, each mounted according to her rank, the wives of the king went out from the city, surrounded by aged men. And Rtvijas went round the corpse on the king who performed many sacrifices leaving it on the left side.

sa: संरक्तनयनः श्रीमान् संचचार कृताञ्जलिः। बभूवावस्थितस्तत्र कल्पवृक्षो महानिव ॥
en: And with eyes reddened, and his hands folded, the graceful Sugrīva came (before Laks maņa) and stood there like a mighty Kalpa tree.

sa: भरतस्तु रथस्थः सञ्श्रीमान् दशरथात्मजः। वाहयन्तं रथश्रेष्ठं सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: That son of Dasaratha, the beauteous Bharata, while proceeding on his car, addressed the charioteer as he drove that best of cars, saying.

sa: अलं वैक्लव्यमालम्ब्य धैर्यमात्मगतं स्मर। त्वद्विधानां न सदृशमीदृशं बुद्धिलाघवम्॥
en: Do not be overwhelmed with grief: summon the fortitude that is in you. Such lightness of sense does not become persons like you.

sa: दुःखस्यानुचितो दुःखं सुमन्त्र शयनोचितः। भूमिपालात्मजो भूमौ शेते कथमनाथवत्॥
en: Unworthy of privations, and worthy of excellent beds, how, O Sumantra, a king's son, he is sleeping on the ground like one forlorn?

sa: गुहोऽपि सह सूतेन सौमित्रिमनुभाषयन्। अन्वजाग्रत् ततो राममप्रमत्तो धनुर्धरः॥
en: Then bow in hand and with his wits about him, conversing with Sumitra's son along with the charioteer, Guha remained awake, watching Rama.

sa: सहसा युद्धशोण्डेन हयारोहेण वाहिताम्। निहतां प्रतिसैन्येन वडवामिव पातिताम्॥
en: Like a mare, suddenly urged on by a rider skilled in battle, lying (on the ground), having been slain by the hostile forces.

sa: किमायासेन ते भीरु उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ शोभने। तत्त्वं मे ब्रूहि कैकेयि यतस्ते भयमागतम्। तत् ते व्यपनयिष्यामि नीहारमिव रश्मिवान्॥
en: What, O timid one, is the use of afflicting yourself thus? O beauteous damsel, arise, arise. Do you, O Kaikeyi, unfold to me the cause whence has proceeded your fear. On hearing the reason, I will dispel it, even as the sun dried up the due.

sa: आमन्त्रयेऽहं भगवन् कामं त्वामृषिसत्तम। समीपं प्रस्थितं भ्रातुमैत्रेणेक्षस्व चक्षुषा।७।।
en: Now, O best of ascetics, I beseech you to look with a propitious eye on me who am bound for my brother's place.

sa: विश्वामित्रोऽपि धर्मात्मा भूयस्तेपे महातपाः। पुष्करेषु नरश्रेष्ठ दशवर्षशतानि च॥
en: O Rāma, And, O best of men, the righteous Viśvāmitra of mighty asceticism again carried on austerities at Puskara for ten hundred years.

sa: प्रत्याश्वस्तो यदाराजा मोहात् प्रत्यागतस्मृतिः। तदाजुहाव तं सूतं रामवृत्तान्तकारणात्॥
en: When having been ministered to and when his senses has returned after the swoon, the king summoned Sumantra for hearing tidings of Rama.

sa: ततः परमगम्या स्याद् दिक्पूर्वा त्रिदशावृता। रहिता चन्द्रसूर्याभ्यामदृश्या तमसावृता॥
en: Beyond that, is the exceedingly impassable Eastern quarter, thronged by the celestials, covered with darkness and devoid of the sun and the moon.

sa: लघुत्वेनोपपन्नं तद् विचित्रं सागरेऽपतत्। दुमाणां विविधं पुष्पं कपिवायुसमीरितम्॥ पुष्पौघेण सुगन्धेन नानावर्णेन वानरः। बभौ मेघ इवोद्यन् वै विद्युद्गणविभूषितः॥
en: And blown by the wind caused by the a monkey, the various variegated flowers of the trees the consequence of their lightness, showered down on the sea. And covered with heaps of fragrant flowers of diverse hues, the monkey resembled a mass of clouds embellished by lines of lightning

sa: ततो वितिमिराः सर्वा दिशश्चोपदिशस्तथा। सुराः सर्षिगणा रामं प्रशशंसुरुदायुधम्॥
en: Then all the quarters became cleared of gloom; and the celestials and saints fell to extol Rāma when he had shot the arrow.

sa: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य सांकाश्यादागतः पुरात्। सुधन्वा वीर्यवान् राजा मिथिलामवरोधकः॥
en: It came to pass that on one occasion a certain powerful king named Sudhanvan came before Mithilā intending to lay siege to it.

sa: शुद्धात्मन् प्रेमभावाद्धि भविष्यामि विकल्मषा। भर्तारमनुगच्छन्ती भर्ता हि परदैवतम्॥
en: O you, pure-hearted one, surely shall I become sinless if I follow my husband, out of affection; for my husband is my Divinity.

sa: हृष्यन्त्य॒तुमुखं दृष्ट्वा नवं नवमिवागतम्। ऋतूनां परिवर्तेन प्राणिनां प्राणसंक्षयः॥
en: People are exhilarated at the commencement of a new season of novel fashion; creatures get their lives shortened at the change of season.

sa: त्वद्विधा नहि शोचन्ति सततं सर्वदर्शनाः। सुमहत्स्वपि कृच्छ्रेषु रामानिर्विण्णदर्शनाः॥
en: O Rāma, persons, highly experienced and ascertaining right or wrong without being moved, do not lament even in the face of mighty perils.

sa: तथाविधं द्विजं दृष्ट्वा निषादेन निपातितम्। ऋषेर्धर्मात्मनस्तस्य कारुण्यं समपद्यत॥
en: Finding the bird in that condition thus brought down by the fowler, the pity of that pious and righteous-souled Rși was excited exceedingly.

sa: तस्याः शङ्कामयं दुःखं मुहूर्तमपि नोत्सहे। मनसि प्रतिसंजातं सौमित्रेऽहमुपेक्षितुम्।७।।
en: Oh, son of Sumitra, I cannot neglect for a moment the trouble which has arisen in her mind on account of this fear.

sa: तत्र कृष्णाजिनधरं जटामण्डलधारिणम्। ददर्श नियताहारं मारीचं नाम राक्षसम्॥
en: And there he saw a Rākṣasa, named Mārīca, clad in a dark deer-skin, bearing a head of matted locks, subsisting on restricted fare.

sa: भगवन् व्रणयुक्तत्वाल्लज्जया चाकुलेन्द्रियः। परिश्रान्तो न शक्नोमि वचनं परिभाषितुम्॥
en: O reverend sire, in consequence of my body suffering from sores, I, my senses bewildered from shame, and myself fatigued, cannot utter words.

sa: न झतिक्रमितं शक्तस्तव वाक्यं महीपतिः। मन्दस्वभावे बुध्यस्व सौभाग्यबलमात्मनः॥
en: Therefore the monarch can never set aside your word. O senseless lady, do you now reflect upon the strength of your good fortune.

sa: रक्ष्यतां नगरी शूरैरङ्गदश्चाभिषिच्यताम्। पदस्थं वालिनः पुत्रं भजिष्यन्ति प्लवङ्गमाः॥
en: Let the heroes defend the city and install Angada on the throne. And on his being installed the monkeys shall serve Vāli's son.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा निपुणं सर्वं भरतः सह मन्त्रिभिः। इङ्गुदीमूलमागम्य रामशय्यामवैक्षत॥
en: Having heard everything, Bharata in company with the counsellors went to the foot of the Ingudi tree and saw the bed of Rāma.

sa: ततो नालीकनाराचैस्तीक्ष्णाग्रैश्च विकर्णिभिः। आजघान रणे रामं तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्॥
en: As a mighty elephant is struck with the goad, Rāma in the conflict attacked (his opponent) with nalikas and nārācas and sharp-pointed vikarna.

sa: श्रोतव्यं सर्वमेतस्य भवद्भिदिष्टकारिभिः। गुरुरेष महाबाहुः श्वशुरो मे महाबलः॥
en: You, abiding by his orders, should listen to all that he sayeth. My mighty-armed father-in-law, gifted with great strength, is my spiritual preceptor.

sa: तमेवमुक्वा देवेशस्त्रिदिवं पुनरभ्यगात्। विश्वामित्रो महातेजा भूयस्तेपे महत् तपः॥
en: Having spoken thus to him, the lord of celestials returned to heaven. And Viśvāmitra of mighty energy became again engaged in rigid austerities.

sa: स बद्धो वाग्भिरग्र्याभिरभितुष्टाव वै सुरो। इन्द्रमिन्द्रानुजं चैव यथावन्मुनिपुत्रकः॥
en: Being bound (to the stake), the ascetic's son first of all duly hymned Agni, and next those deities, Indra and his younger brother.

sa: कृत्वा शापसमायुक्तान् पुत्रान् मुनिवरस्तदा। शुनःशेपमुवाचार्तं कृत्वा रक्षां निरामयाम्॥
en: Having cursed his sons, that best of ascetics then, by all means cheering up the distressed Śunaḥsepa as to his protection, addressed him.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणं सौमित्रिं करुणं साश्रुपातनम्। हनूमान् प्रत्युवाचेदं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः॥ ईदृशा बुद्धिसम्पन्ना जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः। द्रष्टव्या वानरेन्द्रेण दिष्ट्या दर्शनमागताः॥
en: When Sumitrā's son shedding tears had spoken thus, that one skilled in speech, Hanumān, answered in these words, 'Persons of such a stamp, endued with understanding, of controlled anger and subdued senses, should be seen by the master of monkeys, and such come within one's ken through blessed luck.

sa: ततः प्रासादहाणि विमानशिखराणि च। अभिरुह्य जनः श्रीमानुदासीनो व्यलोकयत्॥
en: Then crowds of elegantly-attired citizens, mounting on the terraces of three-storied and seven-storied houses, looked on the scene with hearts filled with sorrow.

sa: सर्वोपायं तु वर्तिष्ये विनिवर्तयितुं बलात्। समक्षमार्यमिश्राणां साधूनां गुणवर्तिनाम्॥
en: I will in presence of this mixed assembly of pious and honourable persons following every perfection, adopt every expedient to bring back Rāma.

sa: विसर्जयनान् सचिवान् यथापुरमरिंदम। ततः क्रीडामहे सर्वा वनेषु मदनोत्कटाः॥
en: O slayer of foes, do you despatch your counsellors to the city and we shall all enjoy in this forest, excited with amour.

sa: प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां भरद्वाजमुपागमत्। उवाच नरशार्दूलो मुनिं ज्वलिततेजसम्॥
en: When the night had passed away and day dawned, (Rāma) approached Bharadvāja, and that chief of men addressed that ascetic of flaming energy.

sa: स चास्य कथयामास शबरी धर्मचारिणीम्॥ श्रमणां धर्मनिपुणामभिगच्छेति राघव।
en: And the Rākşasa addressed Rama saying, O descendant of Raghu, Do you repair to the ascetic, Śabarī, conversant with all systems of morality.

sa: चिन्तयानस्य तस्यैवं बुद्धिरासीन्महात्मनः। सुतार्थं वाजिमेधेन किमर्थं न यजाम्यहम्॥
en: Mentally turning the matter over, the highsouled one thought, Why do I not celebrate a horse-sacrifice with the intention of obtaining a son?

sa: इदमेव स्मराम्यस्याः सहसैवोपजल्पितम्। कैकेयीसंश्रितं जल्पं नेदानी प्रतिभाति माम्॥
en: This only I remember; but all that she had from sudden impulse communicated to me or concerning Kaikeyſ, does not rise into consciousness.

sa: नाश्रेयसि रतो यश्च न विरुद्धकथारुचिः। उत्तरोत्तरयुक्तीनां वक्ता वाचस्पतिर्यथा॥
en: He was never engaged in forbidden piactises; and never relished improper talk; and argued in chain even like the lord of speech himself.

sa: ज्येष्ठोऽवितस्त्वं सम्पाते जटायुरनुजस्तव। मानुषं रूपमास्थाय गृह्णीतां चरणौ मम॥
en: You are I know, elder, O Sampati; and Jatayu is younger to you. Assuming human forms, you had taken hold of my feet.

sa: देशकालौ भजस्वाद्य क्षममाणः प्रियाप्रिये। सुखदुःखसहः काले सुग्रीववशगो भव॥
en: Do you place yourself now under the control of Sugrīva, ascertaining time and place, putting up with misery for your welfare and injury.

sa: गच्छता मातुलकुलं भरतेन तदानघः। शत्रुघ्नो नित्यशत्रुघ्नो नीतः प्रीतिपुरस्कृतः॥
en: When Bharata set out for the home of his maternal uncle, he affectionately took with him the sinless Satrughna ever repressing his passions.

sa: अथोपकार्यं जग्मुस्ते सभार्या रघुनन्दनाः। राजाप्यनुययौ पश्यन् सर्षिसङ्घः सबान्धवः॥
en: to The king, having seen that all the auspicious ceremonies were performed, went in their wake accompanied by the sages and his adherents.

sa: विश्वामित्रस्तथेत्युक्त्वा तानृषीन् प्रतिपूज्य च। ततार सहितस्ताभ्यां सरितं सागरङ्गमाम्॥
en: Thereupon saying, So be it! and having paid homage to those ascetics, Viśvāmitra set about crossing that river, which had replenished the ocean.

sa: उषित्वा रजनीं तत्र राजपुत्रावरिंदमौ। महर्षिमभिवाद्याथ जग्मतुस्तं गिरिं प्रति॥
en: Having spent the night there, those princes, repressors of their foes, after paying their obeisance to the Maharși, set out for the mountain.

sa: पितामहानां सर्वेषां त्वमत्र मनुजाधिप। कुरुष्व सलिलं राजन् प्रतिज्ञामपवर्जय॥
en: Do you now, O lord of men, her offer oblations of water to your grand-sires, and thereby, O king, make good your promise.

sa: यस्याः कृते नरव्याघ्रौ जीवनाशमितो गतौ। राजा पुत्रविहीनश्च स्वर्गं दशरथो गतः॥ क्रोधनामकृतप्रज्ञां दृप्तां सुभगमानिनीम्। ऐश्वर्यकामां कैकेयीमनार्यामायरूपिणीम्॥ ममैतां मातरं विद्धि नृशंसां पापनिश्चयाम्। यतोमूलं हि पश्यामि व्यसनं महदात्मनः॥
en: And her in consequence of whose act those foremost of men have come by crushing misfortune, and the king Dasaratha has gone to heaven, deprived of his son, wrathful and proud of her good fortune, setting her heart of wealth, Kaikeyi, dishonourable, although endowed with the semblance of honour, do you know this wicked one intent on sin as my mother. In her do I perceive the root of my mighty misfortune.

sa: ददौ तस्य ततः प्रीतः स्वनामाङ्कोपशोभितम्। अङ्गुलीयमभिज्ञानं राजपुत्र्याः परंतपः॥
en: And well pleased, that subduer of enemies handed to Hanuman a ring inscribed with his name, as a sign to the king's daughter.

sa: यदिहोत्पद्यते भूतं कस्तत् प्रतिसहिष्यति। अभिगम्य सुराः सर्वे प्रणिपत्येदमब्रुवन्॥
en: Who will be able to bear the offspring of this union? And thereupon the celestials repairing to Mahadeva, thus addressed him, saluting low,

sa: प्रभातायां तु शर्वयां पौरास्ते राघवं विना। शोकोपहतनिश्चेष्टा बभूवुर्हतचेतसः॥
en: When the night had departed an day dawned, the citizens not finding Rāghava, overwhelmed with grief and were deprived of their senses. were

sa: अङ्गरागेण दिव्येन लिप्ताङ्गी जनकात्मजे। शोभयिष्यसि भर्तारं यथा श्रीविष्णुमव्ययम्॥
en: O daughter of Janaka, daubing your person with this excellent paint, you will grace your husband even as Śrī does the undeteriorating Visnu.

sa: तस्यास्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा विस्मिता मन्दविस्मया। कृतमित्यब्रवीत् सीता तपोबलसमन्विताम्॥
en: Hearing her words, Sītā, surprised, said with a smile, to that lady equipped with ascetic strength, “All this has been done by you."

sa: निश्चितैव हि मे बुद्धिर्वनवासे दृढव्रता। भरतस्नेहसंतप्ता बालिशीक्रियते पुनः॥
en: Albeit my mind is firm as regards my sojourn in the woods, yet is my mind unsteady, being inflained with affection for Bharata.

sa: तस्या गुहायाः प्राग्द्वारे महाशीतोदको हृदः॥ बहुमूलफलो रम्यो नानानगसमाकुलः।
en: At the entrance of that cave lies a beautiful, wide lake of cool water, hedged on all sides with trees abounding in fruits.

sa: उरोदेशेषु सर्वेषां हारा ज्वलनसंनिभाः। रूपं विभ्रति सौमित्रे पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम्॥
en: Over the breasts of all appear chains of blazing sheen; and, O son of Sumitrā, their beauty appears that of five and twenty.

sa: चैत्रः श्रीमानयं मासः पुण्यः पुष्पितकाननः। यौवराज्याय रामस्य सर्वमेवोपकल्प्यताम्॥
en: This is the holy month of Caitra; and the groves look beautiful with blossoms. Do you now prepare for the installation of Rāma.

sa: पश्यन्निव च तां सीतामपश्यन्मन्मन्थार्दितः। उवाच राघवो वाक्यं विलापाश्रयदुर्वचम्॥
en: Pierced with the shafts of Manmatha, Rāghava, as if beholding Sītā though he actually did not see her, uttered the following piteous accents

sa: सूतस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा वाचा परमदीनया। बाष्पोपहतया सूतमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing the words of the charioteer, the king like an exceedingly forlorn, addressed the former in words lost in the vapour of sorrow.

sa: मेघपर्वतसंकाशाश्छादयन्त इवाम्बरम्। घोररूपाः कपिश्रेष्ठा यान्तु म मच्छासनादितः दितः॥
en: Let (monkey) resembling clouds or mountains, cover up the sky; and let the foremost monkeys of dreadful forms march hence at my command.

sa: सोऽहं न शक्ष्यामि पुनर्नियोगमतिवर्तितुम्। पितुर्हिवचनाद् वीर कैकेय्याहं प्रचोदितः॥
en: While I have been, Oh warrior, ordered by Kaikeyi at my father's words, I shall not be able to transgress those behest's again.

sa: मन्यसे यदि काकुत्स्थ मा स्म शोके मनः कृथाः।।१८ एवमुक्तः स सौहार्दाल्लक्ष्मणेन समाहितः। सह सौमित्रिणा रामो विचेतुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: O Kākutstha, if think you that she is somewhere in this forest, we shall leave no quarter untried. Do you not grieve. After Laks maņa had spoken thus out of fraternal affection, Rāma, with a composed heart, set out along with him in quest of Sītā.

sa: इतो द्वियोजने तात बहुमूलफलोदकः। देशो बहुमृगः श्रीमान् पञ्चवट्यभिविश्रुतः॥
en: Two Yojanas hence, my child, is a region abounding in fruits and roots, containing countless deer, and beautiful-known by the name of Pancavați.

sa: तं समीक्ष्यागतं रामं सुग्रीवः सहलक्ष्मणम्। ह्वीमान् दीनमुवाचेदं वसुधामवलोकयन्॥
en: Beholding Rāma approach with Lakşmaņa, Sugrīva, stricken with shame and casting his looks on the earth, addressed him poorly, with the following words.

sa: अस्मिल्लवणतोये च प्रक्षिप्तः प्लवगोत्तम। गुप्तपक्षः समग्रश्च तव पित्राभिरक्षितः॥
en: O best of monkeys I was these cast done in this salt ocean and preserved unhurt by your ancestors having my wings hid.

sa: तयोरन्वेषतोरेवं सर्वं तद्वनमोजसा। संजज्ञे विपुलः शब्दः प्रभञ्जन्निव तद्वनम्॥
en: Thereupon while they began to explore the entire forest with their prowess there arose a terrible sound as if breaking down the wood.

sa: आराधिता हि शीलेन प्रयत्नैश्चोपसेविताः। राजानः सम्प्रसीदन्ति प्रकुप्यन्ति विपर्यये॥
en: The monarchs are always propitiated by being served with assiduity and good temper; they are offended when any thing contrary to it happens.

sa: समावृण्वन् दिश: सर्वा महेन्द्राशनिनिःस्वनः। सा निशीथे महाराज सेनादृश्यत भारती॥ अङ्गदैः कुण्डलैर्निष्कैः शस्त्रैश्चैवावभासिता। तत्र नागा रथाश्चैव जाम्बूनदविभूषिताः॥
en: And filling all the points like the roar of Mahendra's thunder. (A.d) great king, at that night the Bharata army illuminated with the Angadas, ear-rings, cuirasses and with the weapons could be (clearly) seen. There (on the field of battle) elephants and cars decked with gold.

sa: तान् समेतान् रणे शूरांश्चेदिपञ्चालसृञ्जयान्। समन्ताद् द्रावयन् द्रोणो वह्वशोभत मारिष॥ आकर्णपलितः श्यामो वयसाशीतिपञ्चकः। रणे पर्यचरद् द्रोणो वृद्धः षोडशवर्षवत्॥
en: The Pandavas and the Panchalas were seized with a great panic; then routing completely those assembled host of heroes consisting of Chedis, Panchalas and the Srinjayas, Drona appeared highly beautiful, O sire. With his hoary locks flowing down to the ear, blue in complexion, full eighty-five years of age.

sa: तयोर्युद्धं महाराज चित्ररूपमिवाभवत्। यादृशं हि पुरा वृत्तं रामरावणयोमृधे॥
en: The battle battle between between them was very wonderful, like that which took place between Rama and Ravana in the days of yore.

sa: शोणितैः सिच्यमानानि शस्त्राणि कवचानि च।॥ महारागनुरक्तानि वस्त्राणीव चकाशिरे।
en: Diverse kinds of weapons and armours, that were drenched in blood, blazed forth like pieces of cloth, that are dyed with deep red.

sa: तथा परिवृतं दृष्व द्रोणमाचार्यसत्तमम्। पुत्रास्ते सर्वतो यत्ता ररक्षुर्दोणमाहवे॥
en: Then beholding that foremost of preceptors Drona, thus hemmed in on all sides, your sons, exerting their best, protected Drona in that battle.

sa: धर्मार्थकामं संयुक्तं त्रिवेणु दारु बन्धुरम्। ओषधीर्वीरुधश्चैव घण्टाः पुष्पफलोपगाः॥
en: Virtue, profit and desire, united together constituted its Trivena. And there the herbs, containing innumerable flowers and fruits, formed its rows of bells.

sa: अद्य राधासुतस्याहं संग्रामे मधुसूदन॥ शिरश्छेत्स्यामि कर्णस्य मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्।
en: O Madhusudana, today, I will in the presence of all the archers, marshaled in array, dissever the head of Karna of Radha's womb.

sa: केचिद् वमन्तो रुधिरं भयार्ताः पर्वतोपमाः॥ व्यद्रवञ्छरविद्धागा धातुचित्रा इवाचलाः।
en: With their limbs wounded with arrows, stricken with fear and vomiting blood, some, huge like mountains, fled away like mountains adorned with metals.

sa: हाहाकृतं भृशं लीयमानं परस्परम्। अलातचक्रवात् सैन्यं तदाभ्रमत तावकम्॥
en: Your troops, panic-stricken, kept close to each other and were turning round from this side to that side like a wheel on fire.

sa: कर्णस्तु रथिनां श्रेष्ठश्छाद्यमानः समन्ततः। राजन् व्यसृजदुग्राणि शरवर्षाणि भारत॥
en: Then that foremost of car-warriors viz., Karna covered on all sides with those arrows, Oking, O Bharata, shot numerous fierce arrows at Bhima.

sa: अन्यान्यरक्षितं वीर बलं त्वामभिवर्तते॥ द्रोणपुत्रं पुरस्कृत्य तच्छीघ्रं संनिषूदय।
en: O warrior! Kill immediately the army just ready to attack on you under circle of defence led by Ashvatthama, the son of Drona.

sa: ततो दृष्ट्वा महाराज राजमानौ महारथौ। सिद्धतारणसंघाना विस्मयः समपद्यत॥
en: Those two warriors looked beautiful and brilliant on their cars and they were admired by all the Siddhas and Charanas that were present.

sa: अद्य मद्वाणनिर्दग्धाः पञ्चालाः सोमकास्तथा॥ सिंहेनेवादिता गावो विद्रविष्यन्ति सर्वशः।
en: Today the Chedis, the Panchalas and the Somakas, scorched with my darts, like cows afflicted by a lion, will fly on all sides.

sa: अनेकान् विप्रकारांश्च सूतपुत्रसमुद्भवान्। स्मरमाणः कथं भीमो युयुधे सूतसूनुना॥
en: How did Bhima fight with that son of a charioteer, remembering the numerous wrongs inflicted on them to have their cause in him?

sa: भीरूणां त्रासजनने शूराणां हर्षवर्धने। प्रवादितासु भेरीषु झर्झरेष्वानकेषु च॥
en: Sound that struck the hearts of the cowards with terror and enhanced the delight of the brave and while drums, Jarajhwaras and cymbals.

sa: तेषां संलोड्यमानानां पाण्डवैर्हतचेतसाम्। अन्धे तमसि मग्नानामभवत् का पतिस्तदा॥
en: Crushed and deprived of senses by the Pandavas and buried in blinding darkness (as they were), what was (the state of) their mind?

sa: पृष्ठगोपास्तु तस्यासन् सौमदत्तिपुरोगमाः। कृपश्च वृषसेनश्च शल: शल्यश्च दुर्जयः॥
en: A number of other warriors headed by Somadattas' son, viz., Kripa,, Vrishasena, Shala and the invincible Shalya were engaged in protecting his rear.

sa: किमु मानुषमात्रेण शक्य:स्यात् प्रतिवीक्षितुम्। दृढमुष्टिः कृती नित्यमस्यमानो दिवानिशम्॥
en: Of firm grasp, accomplished in the use of weapons, incessantly shooting his weapons, he could not have been looked at by mere men?

sa: चिकीर्षुर्दुष्करं कर्म पार्षतः परवीरहा। ईषया समतिक्रम्य द्रोणस्य रथमाविशत्॥
en: Leap over the shafts of Drona's car and entered into it. He then stood sometimes on the yoke and sometimes on its joints.

sa: तैः पतद्भिर्महाराज द्रौणिमुक्तैः समन्ततः। संछादितौ रथस्थौ तावुभौ कृष्णधनंजयौ॥
en: And their dangerous arrows discharged by Drona's son, O king, falling on Krishna and Dhananjaya, entirely enshrouded both of them on their car.

sa: प्रभातायां रजन्यां तु कर्णो राजानमभ्ययात्। समेत्य च महाबाहुदुर्योधनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus when the night dawned, Karna went of the king. And having approached him that hero of very powerful arms then addressed Duryodhana.

sa: न कंचिदवमन्येऽहमापदो मां समुद्धर। तमेवं वादिनं दीनं विलपन्तमचेतनम्॥
en: If I, O swan, O lord, return safely to my country I will never disregard any body; Oh, save me from this calamity."

sa: तं तथा समरे कर्म कुर्वाणमतिमानुषम्। परिवर्महाराज पञ्चालानां रथव्रजाः॥
en: While he was performing those superhuman feats in battle a large number of Panchala cars surrounded him quickly on all sides, O king.

sa: विपताकं वियन्तारं विवर्मध्वजजीवितम्। तं कृत्वा द्विरदं भूयं सहदेवोऽङ्गमभ्ययात्॥
en: Then Shahadeva, after having deprived that elephant of his banners, driver, armour, standard and life, again advanced against the ruler of the Angas.

sa: तस्य शब्देन वित्रस्ताः प्राद्रवंस्तावका युधि। क्षत्रधर्मं समुत्सृज्य पलायनपरायणाः॥
en: At that sound your troops, panic stricken, began to fly away; and disregarding the duties of Kshatriyas they exerted themselves in flying away.

sa: घटोत्कचप्रयुक्तेन सिंहनादेन भीषिताः। प्रसुस्रवुर्गजा मूत्रं विव्यथुश्च नरा भृशम्॥
en: Struck with panic by the leonine roars sent forth by Ghatotkacha, the elephants began to pass urine and the kings were greatly distressed.

sa: तेषां त्राणार्थमुद्यन्तं वधार्थं द्विषतामपि॥ विद्धि मामास्थितं वृत्तं पौरूरवसमुत्तमम्।
en: I am bent upon rescuing the Kauravas and killing my enemies; know that I am determined upon imitating the excellent conduct of Pururavas.

sa: तत् सम्पूज्य वचोऽक्रूरं सर्वसैन्यानि भारत। मुहूर्तमखपन् राजश्रान्तानि भरतर्षभ॥
en: Then applauding those noble words of Arjuna, O Bharata, O foremost of men, the fatigued troop laid themselves down only for a moment.

sa: ततो द्रौणिः प्रहस्यैनं द्रवन्तमभिभाष्य च। अवाकिरत् प्रदीप्ताग्रैः शरैस्तैरभिमन्त्रितैः॥
en: Thereupon Drona's son smilingly eyeing the rushing Bhima, challenged him and then covered him with arrows of keen points and inspired with Mantras.

sa: महावेगैः प्रसन्नाग्रैः शातकुम्भपरिष्कृतैः। अहमद् भरतश्रेष्ठं भीमं वैकर्तनः शरैः॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, Vikartana's son then wounded Bhima with many shafts of keen points and great impetuosity and decked with gold.

sa: सुप्ताः शुशुभिरे तत्र निःश्वसन्तो महीतले। विकीर्णा गिरयो यद्वन्निःश्वसद्भिर्महोरगैः॥
en: The elephants, as they breathed on the ground, appeared beautiful like mountains (scattered over the field of battle) on which mighty serpents hissed.

sa: नैनं निरीक्षितुं कश्चिदशक्नोद् द्रौणिमाहवे। ऋते घटोत्कचाद् वीराद् राक्षसेन्द्रान्महाबलात्॥
en: None else could look at the son of Drona in that encounter except Ghatotkacha, the heroic and highly powerful king of the Rakshasas.

sa: कृतेऽवहारे सैन्यानां प्रवृत्ते च रणे पुनः॥ कथं वैकर्तनः कर्णस्तत्रायुध्यत संजय। कथं च पाण्डवाः सर्वे युयुधुस्तत्र सूतजम्॥
en: O Sanjaya, how did Karna, the son of Vikartana, fight there (in the field of battle), when my troops had first re-retreated and again engaged themselves in the battle. And how also did the sons of Pandu fight in the field with the son of Suta?

sa: युयुत्सुश्च ततो राजशितधारेण पत्रिण। उलूकं ताडयामास वज्रेणेव महाबलम्॥
en: Thereupon, O monarch, Yuyutsu afflicted Uluka with a sharp-edged arrow (supplied with wings), even as a huge mountain is struck with the thunderbolt.

sa: कचित् तीर्णप्रतिज्ञं हि वासुदेवेन रक्षितम्॥ अनस्तमित आदित्ये समेष्याम्यहमर्जुनम्।
en: Shall I behold Arjuna again before the sun set, when he will return having fulfilled his vow through the help of Vasudeva's son?

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान्। आददेऽन्यद् धनुःश्रेष्ठं द्रोणस्यान्तचिकीर्षया॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, excited to his highest pitch of fury, the puissant Dhristadyumna grasped another strong bow, desirous of accomplishing Drona's destruction.

sa: असिमार्गान् बहुविधान् विचेरुः सैनिकारणे। ऋष्टिभिः शक्तिभिः प्रासैः शूलतोमरपट्टिशैः॥
en: The soldiers then roamed over the field, performing various evolutionary movements performed by swords-men. With darts, lances, javelins, tridents, tomaras and battle axes.

sa: व्याघ्रा इव जिघांसन्तस्त्वदीयाः समुपाद्रवन्। द्रोणानीकमतिक्रान्तं भोजानीकं च दुस्तरम्॥
en: Your troops desirous of slaying assailed with fury. After Satyaki had passed through Drona's division and the uncrossable oceanlike division of the Bhojas.

sa: पत्तींश्च निहतान् वीर शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। धनुर्भृतश्चर्मभृतः शयानान् रुधिरोक्षितान्॥
en: Hundreds and thousands of foot-soldiers, O hero, are lying slain (on the ground) in a pool of blood wielding their bows and shields.

sa: तं रथस्थं महाबाहुं युद्धायामिततेजसम्॥ दुर्योधनस्तु राधेयमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। अकृतं द्रोणभीष्माभ्यां दुष्करं कर्म संयुगे॥ कुरुष्वाधिरथे वीर मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्।
en: Duryodhana invited to battle that mighty armed son of Radha of incomparable energy stationed on the car saying-O hero, O carwarrior, do you perform in the presence of all bond men an action, hard of accomplishment which had not been performed even by Bhishma and Drona.

sa: त्वत्सेनाः सर्वतो दृष्ट्वा लोमहर्षणमद्भुतम्। त्वरध्वमिति चाक्रन्दन् नैतदस्तीति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: Your armies excited by seeing that excellent and thrilling experience began to cry on their follows-"Bravo! It cannot be so. Pursue them immediately.

sa: अभ्यवर्तत संग्रामे भारद्वाजं युयुत्सया॥ ततः प्रववृते राजन्नस्तंगच्छति भास्करे।
en: He then rushed furiously against the son of Bharadvaja for slaying him. Then, O king, as the sun was hanging down the horizon.

sa: यादृशं दृश्यते रूपन्तकप्रतिमं भृशम्। गमिष्यत्यद्य पदवी भारद्वाजस्य गौतमः॥
en: Gautama, who exactly appears even like the most dreadful Destroyer himself, will he not obtain today the appellation of the son of Bharadvaja?

sa: पञ्चालाः कुरवश्चैव योधयन्तः परस्परम्। यमराष्ट्राय महते परलोकाय दीक्षिताः॥
en: The Panchalas and the Kauravas, determined to go to the next world, that is, the great region of Yama, fought with one another.

sa: तावन्योन्यं दृढं विद्धावन्योन्यशरपीडितौ। रेजतुः समरे राजन् पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: Then those heroes piercing each other deeply and each afflicted with the shafts of the other, shone, Oking, like two blossoming Kinshuka trees.

sa: सात्यकिं व्याघ्रदत्तस्तु शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। चक्रेऽदृश्यं साश्वसूतं सध्वजं पृतनान्तरे॥
en: Then in the midst of the troops Vyaghradatta rendered Satyaki, his horses, charioteer and and standard, invisible, with numerous shafts of depressed knots.

sa: व्यसने वर्तमानस्य कृतवर्मा नृशंसवत्। अश्वाञ्जधान सहसा तथोभौ पाणिसारथी॥
en: Like one heartless, Kritavarman slew the four steeds and the two drivers of Abhimanyu when the latter was involved in a great predicament.

sa: हत्वा बहुविधाः सेनाः पाण्डूनां युद्धदुर्मदः। कथंचित् संकटान्मुक्तो मत्तद्विरदविक्रमः॥
en: As also with with the Prabhadrakas the Panchalas and the Chedis accompanied by the Kekayas. Having slain numerous indomitable troops of the Pandavas.

sa: तस्मिञ्जनसमुन्नादे प्रवृत्ते भैरवे सति। कदर्थीकृत्य ते पुत्रः प्रत्यमित्रमवारयत्॥
en: When that loud and dreadful uproar was set up by your people, your son pressing his foe hard, began to impede his progress.

sa: तांश्च सर्वान् महेष्वासान् सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रपारगः॥ महता शरवर्षेण राधेयः प्रत्यवारयत्।
en: With a huge downpour of arrows the son of Radha who had mastered all sorts of weapons withstood all those great bow men.

sa: शौरेरभीषुहस्तस्य पार्थस्य च धनुष्मतः। तयोरासीत् प्रभा राजन् सूर्यपावकयोरिव॥
en: The radiance of Shauri holding the reins and Partha wielding the bow, O king, was like that of the fire and the sun.

sa: महाशिलाश्चापतस्तत्र तव सहस्रशः साशनयश्च वज्राः। चक्राणि चानेकशतक्षुराणि प्रादुर्बभूवुर्खलनप्रभाणि॥
en: Large stones drooped from it and thousands of thunderbolts with loud clap and hundreds of wheels and razors of the effulgence of fire.

sa: तौ शरैश्छादयामास विराटदुपदावुभौ। द्रोणेन च्छाद्यमानौ तु क्रुद्धौ संग्राममूर्धनि॥
en: Covered the two, Drupada and Virata with his own arrows. Thus covered by Drona and inflamed with wrath at the head of battle.

sa: अहं हि ज्वलतां मध्ये मयूखानामिवांशुमान्। प्रयोक्ता देवसृष्टानामस्राणां पृतनागतः॥
en: Today at the heart of the hostile troops, like the sun in the midst of scorching rays, I shall discharge my celestial weapons.

sa: गजाश्वरथसंयुक्तो वृतश्चैव पदातिभिः। दुर्योधनो महाराज प्रायात् तत्र महारथः॥
en: Your the mighty car-warrior Duryodhana also, O king, then fled from the field attended by cars, elephants and steeds and surrounded by foot-soldiers.

sa: गजा गजान् समासाद्य विषाणैरार्दयन् नृप। विषाणाभिहतास्तत्र भ्राजन्ते द्विरदास्तथा॥
en: O king, the elephants approaching other elephants tore one another with their tusks. Stuck with the tusks of assailing elephants they looked beautiful.

sa: दुःशासनस्त्ववस्थाप्य स्वमनीकममर्षणः। सात्यकि प्रत्ययौ क्रुद्धः शूरो रथवरं युधि॥
en: The vindictive Dushasana inflamed with rage and inspired with courage and heading his own troops, advanced upon that foremost of car-warriors viz. Satyaki.

sa: पश्य सात्वत भीमाभ्यां निरुद्धाधिष्ठिताः पुनः। जिहीर्षवोऽमृतं दैत्याः शक्रग्निभ्यामिवासकृत्॥
en: See, obstructed by Satvata and Bhima, they have become motionless like unto the Dailyas desirous of pilfering ambrosia stupefied by Sakra and Agni.

sa: निपेतुरुर्व्य समरे कर्णसायकताडिताः॥ कुर्वन्तो विविधान् नादान् वज्रनुन्ना इवाचलाः।
en: Others, oppressed by Karna's arrows, cried aloud in diverse voice and fell down as do the mountain peaks when struck down with thunder.

sa: पाण्डवानामयं कोपस्त्वया शकुनिना सह। आहृतो धृतराष्ट्रस्य सम्मते कुरुसंसदि॥
en: The wrath that you excited in the Pandavas with the assent of Dhritarashtra and associated with Shakuni in the midst of the Kurus,

sa: तमिषु संहतं तेन भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। दृष्ट्वामन्यत देहस्य कालपर्यायमागतम्॥
en: Seeing then that arrow directed at him, the mighty son of Bharadvaja considered that the last day of the corporal existence had arrived.

sa: ते शरा हेमविकृता गाण्डीवप्रेषिता भृशम्। द्रौणिमासाद्य विविशुर्वल्मीकमिव फन्नगाः॥
en: Those golden shafts, shot off his Gandiva, approached the son of Drona and wounded him deep like serpents entering into an ant hill.

sa: ततो निष्ठानको घोरः पाण्डवानामजायत। द्रोणेन वध्यमानेषु सैन्येषु भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Who, O foremost of the Bharatas, the Pandava troops were thus being slaughtered by Drona, a loud wail of agony was uttered them.

sa: सुषेणं च हतोऽसीति बुवन्नादत्त सायकम्। तमस्य कर्णश्चिच्छेद त्रिभिश्चैनमताडयत्॥
en: Then saying to Sushena "you are killed” Bhima took up another arrow. Karna cut it off and pierced Bhima himself with three arrows.

sa: ततो द्रोणो भृशं क्रुद्धो धर्मराजस्य मारिष॥ चतुर्भिनिशितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्हयाञ्जने शरोत्तमैः।
en: Then highly enraged, O sire, Drona slew the horses of the very virtuous virtuous king Yudhishthira, with four excellent sharp shafts of keen-points.

sa: स्यालौ तव महाराज राजानौ वृषकाचलौ। त्वदर्थमतिविक्रान्तौ निहतौ सव्यसाचिना॥
en: O powerful monarch, your brothers-in-law, the prince Vrishaka and Achala, displaying their inighty prowess in battle for your sake, were slain by Savyasachin.

sa: विक्रम्य वारिता राजन् वीरेण कृतवर्मणा॥ यतमानांश्च तान् सर्वानीषद्विगतचेतसः।
en: O king, then putting forth his energy, the heroic Kritavarman resisted all his focs who though depressed at first were then exerting vigorously.

sa: मृत्योरास्यं व्यात्तमिवाभिपद्य प्रभद्रकाः कर्णमासाद्य राजन्। स्तदा कर्णः प्राहिणोन्मृतयुसद्म॥
en: Karna has already killed seventeen hundred of these car-warriors. The son of Suta did not lose heart till he came to our view.

sa: तमापतन्तं सहसा घोररूपं विशाम्पते। चिच्छेद शतधा राजशैनेयः कृतहस्तवत्॥
en: O king, the descendant of Sini, like an expert, sundered into seven pieces that dreadful arrow which was about to fall on him.

sa: मन्दरश्मिः सहस्रांशुरस्तं गिरिमुपाद्रवत्। ततो राजन् हृषीकेशः संग्रामशिरसि स्थितम्॥
en: The thousand-rayed (deity) with his rays dimmed entered into the setting hill. Then stationed at the head of the battle, O king, Hrishikesa.

sa: दन्तवर्णांस्तु राधेयो निजघान मनोजवान्। युधिष्ठिरस्य संग्रामे कालवालान् हयोत्तमान्॥
en: Then in the battle Radha's son killed Yudhishthira's most excellent horses white as the teeth, quick-coursing like the mind and having black tails.

sa: एवं ब्रुवति कौन्तेये दाशार्हस्त्वरितस्ततः। निवार्य सैन्यं बाहुभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: When the son of Kunti was thus speaking, the scion of the Dasaratha race, Krishna, forbidding the troops with the waive of his

sa: उभयोः सेनयो?रं परस्परजिगीषया॥ अर्जुनः कौरवं सैन्यमर्जुनं चापि कौरवाः। नानाशस्त्रसमावायैरन्योयं समपीडयन्॥ द्रौणिः पाञ्चालराजं च भारद्वाजश्च सुंजयान्। छादयांचक्रतुः संख्ये शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ पाण्डुपाञ्चालसैन्यानां कौरवाणां च भारत। आसीनिष्टानको घोरो निजतामितरेतरम्॥
en: Between the two armies, both desirous of victory, O king, Arjuna, (then), began to sorely assailed the army of the Kauravas and Arjuna, with numerous (sorts of) weapons. (And) in that engagement the son of Drona began to cover the Panchala king and the son of Bharadvaja, the Srinjayas, with straight arrows. (And) O Bharata, as the armies of the Pandavas and the Panchalas (on one side) and that of the Kauravas (on the other).

sa: जघान मिषतः संख्ये भीमसेनस्य राक्षसः। सोऽवतीर्य रथोपस्थाद्धताश्वो हतसारथिः॥
en: Even, O Bharata, before the very eyes of Bhima himself. Then deprived of his horses and charioteer Bhima, jumping down from his chariot.

sa: तं कृच्छ्रामापदं प्राप्तं दृष्ट्वा परमधन्विनः। समापेतुः परीप्सन्तो धनंजयशरादितम्॥
en: Then they surrounded Dhananjaya with thousands of duly equipped chariots and elephants and horses and numerous divisions of infantry, all inspired with wrath.

sa: अशोभन्त यथा मेघाः शारदाश्चलविद्युतः। योधास्ते तु महाराज क्रोधामर्षसमन्विताः॥
en: Appeared beautiful like vast masses of clouds in the autumnal sky. Then those warriors, O mighty-monarch, inspired with rage and thought of rivenge.

sa: तौ परस्परवेगाच शराभ्यां च भृशाहतौ। निपेततुर्महावीयौ रथोपस्थे तयोस्तदा॥
en: The two highly-energetic warriors, deeply struck with those two arrows by their respective forces, then fell down at the back of their cars.

sa: संजय उवाच बृहत्क्षत्रमथायान्तं कैकेयं दृढविक्रमम्। क्षेमधूतिर्महाराज विव्याधोरसि मार्गणैः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O mighty monarch, Kshemadhurti, with numerous shafts pierced the advancing Brihatkshatra, that valorous prince of the Kekayas, on the breast.

sa: एवमुक्तो महाबाहुः पार्थः पुष्करलोचनः। आजुहावाथ तद् रक्षस्तचासीत् प्रादुरग्रतः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to the mighty-armed Partha possessed of eyes resembling lotus petals, summoned the Rakshasa. Thereupon the Rakshasa appeared before him.

sa: प्रापतन् स्यन्दनेभ्यस्ते सार्ध सूतैर्गतासवः। चित्रपुष्पधरा भग्ना वातेनेव महाद्रुमाः॥
en: They then fell down dead from their cars, after their charioteers, like so many mighty trees decked with flowers, overthrown by a hurricane.

sa: तं नामृष्यत संक्रुद्धो ह्यवमानं युधिष्ठिरः। अपविध्य धनुश्छिन्नं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः॥ अन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय धर्मपुत्रश्चमूमुखे। दुर्योधनस्य चिच्छेद ध्वजं कार्मुकमेव च॥
en: Yudhishthira, who became highly enraged, did not indeed, car that insult. Then the son of Dharma, whose eyes became red with wrath, throwing aside his severed bow and grasping another bow, stood at the head of his army and cut-off the standard and bow of Duryodhana.

sa: अपयास्यसि चेत्युक्त्वा रणं मुक्तो भविष्यसि। एवमाभाष्य चान्योन्यं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनौ।॥
en: If, however, you run away (from the field), you may be freed (from me).' Thus addressing each other, with eyes reddened with rage.

sa: सहस्राक्षसमं चैव सिद्धचारणमानवाः। भूरिश्रवसमालोक्य युद्धे प्रायगतं हतम्॥ अपूजयन्त तं देवा विस्मितास्तेऽस्य कर्मभिः। पक्षवादांश्च सुबहून् प्रावदंस्तव सैनिकाः॥
en: Then the Siddhas, the Charanas and the men present, as also the celestials, seeing the Indra-like Bhurisravas slain in battle when sitting in the observance of the vow Praya, began to praise him, struck with wonder at the feats achieved by him. Your troops also argued

sa: अयत्नेनैव तं कर्णः शरैर्भृशमवाकिरत्। भीमसेनं महाबाहुं सैन्धवस्य वधैषिणम्॥
en: Then Karna, indifferently covered Bhima of mighty arms and desirous of the slaughter of the Sindhu king, with a tremendous shower of arrows.

sa: कृत्वावश्यकार्याणि समाश्वस्य च भारत। योगमाज्ञापयामासुयुद्धाय च विनिर्ययुः॥ ते
en: Having finished all the necessary ceremonies and consoled themselves, they, O Bharata, ordered for the array of soldiers and then started for battle.

sa: पुनरप्यतिसंक्रुद्धः सवृकोदरपार्षतान्॥ स नाराच गणैः पार्थान् द्रौणिर्विद्ध्वा महाबलः।
en: Waxing worth again, Drona's son having pierced with numerous shafts those great carwarriors, the of Pritha including Vrikodara and the son of Prishata.

sa: सात्यकिं तु रणे राजन् प्रहसंस्तनयस्तव॥ आकर्णपूर्णैर्निशितैर्विव्याध त्रिंशता शरैः।
en: Then in that battle your son smilingly pierced Satyaki in return with thirty arrows shot from his bow-string drawn back to the ear.

sa: पाञ्चालैः पाण्डववैर्मत्स्यैः कारूषैश्चेदिभिः सह। त्वया गुप्तैरमित्रनैः कृतः शत्रुगणक्षयः॥
en: O destroyer of foes, being under your protection, the Panchala, Pandava, Matsya, Karusa and Chedis hosts have been sweeping away the hostile army.

sa: नदी प्रवर्तयित्वा च बीभत्सुः परवीरहा। वासुदेवमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Vibhatsu, the foremost of men and smiter of hostile warriors after making this bloody stream to flow, spoke the following words to Vasudeva.

sa: कुरुपाण्डवप्रवरा दश राजन् महारथाः। साधु साध्विति वेगेन सिंहनादमथानदन्॥
en: These ten best of mighty car-warriors of the Kuru and the Pandava hosts, applauding Bhima with shouts of 'well-done' 'well-done' uttered their war-cries.

sa: कृताञ्जलिः सुसंवीता स्थिताथ दुपदात्मजा। तस्याश्चापि स धर्मात्माः सत्यवागृषिसत्तमः॥
en: Then the daughter of Drupada, being properly covered with her veil, stood before him with joined hands. That virtuous, truthful and excellent Rishi.

sa: तेऽन्योन्यमभिसम्पूज्य गन्धर्वः पाण्डवाश्च ह। रम्याद् भागीरथीतीराद् यथाकामं प्रतस्थिरे॥
en: Then the Gandharva and the Pandavas, respectfully saluting one another, left the charming banks of the Bhagirathi and went away wherever they liked.

sa: तेभ्यश्च लेभिरे गर्भ क्षत्रियास्ताः सहस्रशः। ततः सुषुविरे राजन्क्षत्रियान्वीर्यवत्तरान्॥
en: Thus thousands of Kshatriya women conceived through these connections with the Brahmanas and O king, thus were born many Kshatriyas of great prowess,

sa: ऋषेस्तस्य तु पुत्रोऽभूगवि जातो महायशाः। शृङ्गी नाम महातेजास्तिग्मवीर्योऽतिकोपनः॥
en: The Rishi had a son, born of a cow, named Shringi. He was greatly renowned, exceedingly powerful and greatly energetic and very wrathful.

sa: प्रोत्साहनं चपाञ्चाल्या भीमस्यात्र महात्मना। कैलासारोहणं प्रोक्तं यत्र यक्षैर्बलोत्कटैः॥
en: The inciting of Bhima against the Kurus by Draupadi. Then is related the ascent of Kailasa by Bhima, where with the powerful Yakshas,

sa: दिष्ट्या कुशलिनौ चेमौ भीमसेनधनंजयौ। पुनः स्वनगरं प्राप्तावक्षताविति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, from good fortune, these two Bhima and Dhananjaya (Arjuna), are well. They have arrived at their own city unwounded”.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा समुदैक्षन्त वासुकिं पन्नगोत्तमम्। वासुकिश्चापि संचिन्त्य तानुवाच भुजङ्गमान्॥
en: Having said this, they all eagerly looked at the best of the snakes, Vasuki. And Vasuki, after reflecting a while, told the snakes,

sa: अथ शुश्राव संगत्या वेदाध्ययननिः :स्वनम्। पृष्ठतः परिपूर्णार्थं षड्भिरङ्गैरलंकृतम्॥
en: He heard from behind, as she neared him, the sound of the well-explained recitations of the Vedas with its six ornaments (of elocution).

sa: ततो वादिनृत्याभ्यामुपातिष्ठन्त तौ स्त्रियः। गीतेश्च स्तुतिसंयुक्तैः प्रीत्या समुपजग्मिरे॥
en: Wishing to please those two (heroes), those damsels danced in accompaniment with music and sang many songs in praise of the mighty brothers.

sa: मणिं तथा समादाय द्रोणपुत्रान्महारथात्। पाण्डवाः प्रददुहृष्टा द्रौपद्यै जितकाशिनः॥
en: The Pandavas took the Jewel on the head of Ashvathama and they with much pleasure presented it to the aggrieved and sorrowing Draupadi.

sa: तस्याः पुत्रं बलं विद्धि सुरां च सुरनन्दिनीम्। प्रजानामनकामानामन्योन्यपरिभक्षणात्॥ अधर्मस्तत्र संजातः सर्वभूतविनाशकः। तस्यापि निर्ऋतिर्भार्या नैर्ऋता येन राक्षसा॥
en: She gave birth to a son, called Bala and a daughter, named Sura, who gives joy to the celestials. And all destroying Adharma was born (of her), when creatures began to devour one another. Niriti was his wife, from whom were born the Rakshasas, called Nairitas.

sa: विरूपरूपः पिङ्गाक्षः करालो घोरदर्शनः। पिशितेप्सुः क्षुधार्तश्च तानपश्यद् यदृच्छया॥
en: Ugly featured, red eyed, fearful and terrible looking, hungry and thirsty he looked around at pleasure and he saw them in that state.

sa: अङ्गेनाङ्गं समापीड्य बाहुभ्यामुभयोरपि। आवृत्य बाहुभिश्चापि उदरं च प्रचक्रतुः॥
en: Each striking every limb of the other, and each catching hold of the other's waist, they hurled each other to a great distance.

sa: तया परिगृहीतांस्तान्दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धः सुरेश्वरः। चक्रेण शितधारेण भृगुपन्याः शिरोऽहरत्॥
en: Having beheld the demons thus helped by Bhrgu's wife, Hari, the king of celestials, enraged, chopped off her head with his sharp discuss.

sa: अपि सर्वेषु लोकेषु पुराणावृषिसत्तमौ। पूजनीयतमावेतावपि सर्वैः सुरासुरैः।२०॥ यक्षराक्षसगन्धर्वनरकिन्नरपन्नगैः।
en: They deserve worship from all the celestial, the Asuras, the Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Gandharvas, the human beings, the Asuras and the Nagas.

sa: तत्र मन्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठस्तपोवृद्धो महाव्रतः। जग्राह पाणिं धर्मात्मा विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम्॥
en: Thereupon the virtuous and veteran Rishi, learned in Mantras and observant of rigid vows, accepted her hands, given to him in due rites.

sa: गुरुवत् पूजयामास कांश्चित् कांश्चिद् वयस्यवत्। कांश्चिदभ्यवदत् प्रेम्णा कैश्चिदप्यभिवादितः॥
en: He worshipped some as his superiors, he welcomed others as his equals; he received some with affection and he worshipped others with reverence.

sa: मुहूर्तेदित आदित्ये सर्वे बालपुरस्कृताः। सदारास्तापसान् द्रष्टुं निर्ययुः पुरवासिनः॥
en: It was soon after sunrise that the citizens all came with their wives and children, placing them in front, to see these ascetics.

sa: बभूव मुदितो राजन् प्रशंसन् केशवार्जुनौ। निवृत्तेष्वथ देवेषु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी॥
en: When the celestial retreated, an invisible voice thus spoke in a loud and deep voice to the deity of one thousand sacrifices (Indra).

sa: आयुधागारमादीप्य दग्ध्वा चैव पुरोचनम्। षट् प्राणिनो निधायेह द्रवामोऽनभिलक्षिताः॥
en: Setting fire to the arsenal, burning Purochana to death and leaving six bodies here, let us escape from this place, unobserved by any.

sa: अथोपविविशुः सर्वे त्रयस्ते पुरुषर्षभाः। सम्प्रदीप्तास्त्रयो लक्ष्या महाध्वर इवाग्नयः॥
en: Blazing forth in their own beauty like the three fires of a great sacrifice, these three best of men then took their seats.

sa: जनमेजयस्य राजर्षेः स महात्मा सदस्तथा। विवेश सहितः शिष्यैर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः॥
en: This illustrious man accompanied by his disciples, learned in the Vedas and the Vedangas, entered the sacrificial grounds of the royal sage Janamejaya.

sa: सततं स्मानुशोचन्तस्तमेव भरतर्षभम्। पौरजानपदाः सर्वे मृतं स्वमिव बान्धवम्॥
en: All the citizens and the people bewailed for that best of the Bharata race (Pandu), as if they had lost their own relative.

sa: राज्यं शशास सुमहद् धर्मेण पृथिवीपते। पितॄन् देवानृषीन् विप्रान् गन्धर्वोरगराक्षसान्॥ नहुषः पालयामास ब्रह्मक्षत्रमथो विशः। स हत्वा दस्युसंघातानृषीन् करमदापयत्॥
en: O king, He ruled his kingdom with great virtue. King Nahusha equally supported the Pitris, the Devas, the Rishis, the Gandharvas, the Nagas, the Rakshasas, the Brahmanas, the Kshatriyas and the Vaishyas. He suppressed all the robbers with a mighty hand; he made Rishis to pay tribute to himself.

sa: तां कुन्ती चारुसर्वाङ्गीमुपाजिघ्रत मूर्धनि॥ प्रीत्या परमया युक्ता आशीर्भिर्युञ्जतातुलाम्।
en: Out of excessive affection Kunti sinelt the head of that maiden of perfectly charming features and she then pronounced infinite blessings upon her.

sa: सुभद्रा युयुजे प्रीत्या पाण्डवेनार्जुनेन ह। अतर्पयच्च कौन्तेयः खाण्डवे हव्यवाहनम्॥ बीभत्सुर्वासुदेवेन सहितो नृपसत्तम। नातिभारो हि पार्थस्य केशवेन सहाभवत्॥
en: Subhadra was much pleased to be united with Arjuna, the son of Pandu. O best of kings, the son of Kunti with Krishna then gratified Agni by giving him the Khandava to burn, The task did not at all appear heavy to Arjuna, assisted as he was by Krishna.

sa: यात्राकालस्य योग्यानि कर्माणि गरुडध्वजः। कर्तुकामः शुचिर्भूत्वा स्नातवान् समलंकृतः॥
en: Being desirous of performing the due rites of departure, the Garuda-bannered hero (Krishna), purified himself by a bath and adorned himself with ornaments.

sa: ततोऽभिगम्य त्वरिता पूर्णेन्दुसदृशानना॥ ववन्दे द्रौपदी भद्रा प्रेष्याहमिति चाब्रवीत्।
en: Then that damsel of the face like the full moon, Bhadra, soon went to Draupadi and worshipped her saying, "I am your maid."

sa: तेन व्याघातमस्त्राणां क्रियमाणमवेक्ष्य च। द्रौणिर्यत्र विरूपाक्षं रुद्रमाराध्य सत्वरः॥
en: Seeing also that the Rakshasa obstructed him in his discharge of weapons, he began to worship the three-eyed divinity and it pacified him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो नगराद् वारणावतात्। सर्वमङ्गलसंयुक्ता यथाशास्त्रमतन्द्रिताः॥ श्रुत्वाऽऽगतान् पाण्डुपुत्रान् नानायानैः सहस्रशः। अभिजग्मुर्नरश्रेष्ठान् श्रुत्वैव परया मुदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Hearing that the sons of Pandu were coming, all the citizens came speedily by thousands, out of the town of Varanavata with joy, on various conveyances, taking with them all the auspicious things as directed by the Shastras in order to receive those best of men.

sa: तदद्भुततमं वाक्यं श्रुत्वागस्त्यस्य राघवः। गौरवाद्विस्मयाच्चैव भूयः प्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Hearing the wondrous words of the great saint Kumbhayoni, Rāma, out of great curiosity and importance of the subject, again asked him, saying.

sa: चन्द्रमास्तु मनस्विन्याः श्वासायाः श्वसनस्तथा। रतायाश्चाप्यहः पुत्रः शाण्डिल्याश्च हुताशनः॥
en: Soma was born of Manasvini and Anila was born of the wise Shvasa. Aha was the son of Rata and Anala of Shandilya.

sa: त्वदर्थमागता भद्रे क्षत्रियः प्रथिता भुवि। एते भेत्स्यन्ति विक्रान्तास्त्वदर्थे लक्ष्यमुत्तमम्। विध्येत य इदं लक्ष्यं वरयेथाः शुभेऽद्य तम्॥
en: And all the Kshatriyas celebrated in the world, O amiable sister, have come for your hand. O blessed girl, these powerful men will (try to) shoot the mark. Among these (heroes) you shall choose him as your husband who will (be able to) shoot the mark.

sa: हिडिम्बं निहतं दृष्ट्वा संहृष्टास्ते तरस्विनः। अपूजयन् नरव्याघ्रं भीमसेनमरिंदमम्॥
en: Seeing Hidimba slain, they were filled with joy and lost on time to congratulate that best of men, that chastiser of foes, Bhimasena.

sa: तथा च पूजयित्वा तं प्रणयात्प्रपितामहम्। उपोपविश्य प्रीतात्मा पर्यपृच्छदनामयम्॥
en: Thus having worshipped him the king bowed to his great grandfather. And having seated himself in joy, he asked him about his welfare.

sa: पूर्व समभवत्तत्र अगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः। नाहं सुतस्तवेत्युक्त्वा मित्रं तस्मादपाक्रमत्॥
en: At first therefrom rose up the illustrious Rși Agastya and saying 'I am not your son' Varuņa was thrown into the pot Mitra.

sa: स नागपुरमागम्य गौतमस्य निवेशने। भारद्वाजोऽवसत् तत्र प्रच्छन्नं द्विजसत्तमः॥
en: Arrived at Hastinapur, the excellent Brahmana, the son of Bharadvaja, (Drona) lived in privacy in the house of the son of Gautama (Kripa).

sa: तमिक्ष्वाकुर्महातेजा जातमात्रमनिन्दितम्। ववे पुरोधसं सौम्य वंशस्यास्य हिताय नः।।।।।
en: O gentle one, the highly effulgent Iksavāku appointed that blameless Rși as the priest of our family as soon as he was born.

sa: धनुषा पीड्यमानस्तु जानुभ्यामगमन्महीम्। तत उत्थाय राजा स स्वराष्ट्राण्यभिजग्मिवान्॥
en: Tossed by the bow he too fell upon his knees on the ground. Rising up, he (at once) left for his own kingdom.

sa: गन्धर्वजानामश्वानामहं पुरुषसत्तम। भ्रातृभ्यस्तव तुभ्यं च पृथग्दाता शतं शतम्॥
en: O excellent man, I desire to give you and your brothers, cach separately, one hundred horses born in the regions of the Gandharvas.

sa: रथन्तर्यां सुतान् पञ्च पञ्चभूतोपमांस्ततः। ईलिनो जनयामास दुष्यन्तप्रभृतीन् नृपान्॥
en: Ilina begot on his wife, Rathantari, five sons, Dushyanta being the eldest. They were all as great in power as the five elements.

sa: अस्त्रज्ञौ तु महावीर्यो सर्वशास्त्रविशारदौ। सात्यकिः कृतवर्मा च नारायणमनुव्रतौ॥
en: Satyaki and Kritavarma, learned in the science of arms, possessed of great prowess, well versed in all the Shastras, ever obedient to Narayana,

sa: अभिवाद्य मुनींस्तांस्तु सर्वानेव कृताञ्जलिः। अपृच्छत् स तपोवृद्धिं सद्भिश्चैवाभिपूजितः॥
en: Having been welcomed with due respect by those holy Rishis, Sauti, with joined hands, asked them all how their depute penances were progressing.

sa: इममव्यक्तरूपं मे गर्भमाधाय सत्तम। कथं त्यक्त्वा महात्मा सन्गन्तुमिच्छस्यनागसम्॥
en: O excellent one, high-souled as you are, why should you leave me who have committed no fault? My conception is not yet apparent."

sa: सोऽपश्यमानस्तमृषि शून्यं दृष्ट्वा तथाऽऽश्रमम्। उवाच क इहेत्युचैर्वनं संनादयन्निव॥
en: Having seen that the Rishi's hermitage was empty, he hailed aloud, "Ho, who is here?" And his voice was echoed in the forest.

sa: महता रथवृन्देन नानारूपेण वासवः। आकाशं समवाकीर्य प्रववर्ष सुरेश्वरः॥
en: The lord of the celestial, Vasava soon covered the sky with masses of clouds of various kinds; he then began to pour fain.

sa: विदुलायाश्च पुत्रस्य प्रोक्तं चाप्यनुशासनम्। कर्णदुर्योधनादीनां दुष्टं विज्ञाय मन्त्रितम्॥
en: Then the story of the training of the son of Vidula;. having heard of the evil counsel of Duryodhana and Karna and others;

sa: धार्तराष्ट्रैश्च सहिताः क्रीडन्तो मुदिताः सुखम्। बालक्रीडासु सर्वासु विशिष्टास्तेजसाभवन्॥
en: They played in great joy with the sons of Dhritarashtra; and they excelled them all in the boyish sports with their superior strength.

sa: इमान्यासनमुख्यानि यथार्हमुपविश्यताम्। रामस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा सर्व एव महर्षयः॥
en: "Do you agreeably to desert take these seats." Hearing Rāma's speech, all the Maharşis sat down on those graceful and elegant golden seats.

sa: ते पूच्छमानाः सहिता वचोऽर्थ्य मन्त्रिणस्तदा। युधिष्ठिरं महाप्राज्ञं यियक्षुमिदमब्रुवन्॥
en: Having been thus asked by the greatly wise Yudhishthira eager to perform the sacrifice, they spoke to him these words of grave import.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्ततः सर्वानर्चयित्वा सभासदः। प्रत्यर्चितश्च तैः सर्वैर्यज्ञायैव मनो दधे॥
en: Having worshipped all his Sabhasadas (counsellors and officers) and having been worshipped by them in return, he consulted with them about the sacrifice.

sa: ततस्तस्यां समुत्पन्ने गर्भे स मुनिसत्तमः। राज्ञाभिवादितस्तेन जगाम मुनिराश्रमम्॥
en: Thereupon, when the queen conceived by him, that best of Rishis (Vasishtha), receiving the salutation of the king, went away to his hermitage.

sa: कदाचिदथ गाङ्गेय सर्वनीतिमतां वरः। विदुरं धर्मतत्त्वज्ञं वाक्यमाह यथोचितम्॥
en: One day the foremost of all statesmen, the learned in all the moral precepts, the son of Ganga (Bhishma), spoke to Vidura thus.

sa: तांश्च वृष्ण्यन्धक श्रेष्ठान् कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। प्रतिजग्राह सत्कारैर्यथाविधि यथागतम्॥
en: The son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, then welcomed with all due ceremonies all the other chief men of the Vrishni and the Andhaka races.

sa: स गत्वा यमुनातीरं सप्तरात्रोषितः पथि। ऋषीणां पुण्यकीर्तीनामाश्रमे वासमभ्ययात्॥
en: And having spent seven nights he at last arrived at the hermitage of the pious Rși living on the banks of the Yamuna.

sa: हषार्दप्रतिमां प्रीतिं प्रापतुःस्म वरस्त्रियौ। वने कदूः सुतान्नागान्सहस्रं तुल्यवर्चसः॥
en: The most beautiful damsels felt a transport of joy. Kadru wished to have one thousand snakes as her sons, all of equal splendour.

sa: ततस्ते शूलमारोप्य तं मुनि रक्षिणस्तदा। प्रतिजग्मुर्महीपालं धनान्यादाय तान्यथ॥
en: Having put them (the thieves) and the Rishi on an iron-spit, they returned to the king with the stolen property they had recovered.

sa: यद्ययं फाल्गुनो युद्धे नाराज्ञा योद्भुमिच्छति। तस्मादेषोऽङ्गविषये मया राज्येऽभिषिच्यते॥
en: But if Falguni is unwilling to fight with one who is not a king, I install him (Karna) as the king of Anga.

sa: एवमुक्तः स तेनर्षिर्वसिष्ठः प्रत्यभाषत। प्रणिपत्य विवस्वन्तं भानुमन्तं महातपाः॥
en: Having been thus addressed after duly bowing down his head to him the Rishi Vasishtha of great ascetic merit, thus replied to Vivasvata.

sa: रुरुचे साधिकं सुभूरापतन्ती नभस्तलात्। सौदामिनीव विभ्रष्टा द्योतयन्ती दिशस्त्विषा॥
en: That maiden of fair eye-brows came down from the sky as lighting comes down from the clouds illuminating the ten points of heaven.

sa: मन्यते स वृतं पुत्रं ज्येष्ठं दुपदकन्यया। दुर्योधनमविज्ञानात् प्रशाचक्षुर्नरेश्वरः॥
en: That king, possessing the eye of knowledge, thought from ignorance that his eldest son Duryodhana had been chosen by the daughter of Drupada.

sa: रामोऽपि मुनिभिः सार्धं पार्थिवैश्च महात्मभिः। श्रुत्वा तदीतिमाधुर्यं कर्मशालामुपागमत्॥
en: There upon having heard that charming song in the company of ascetics and kings the highminded Rāma repaired to the place of business.

sa: एवं स धार्तराष्ट्रांश्च स्पर्धमानो वृकोदरः। अप्रियेऽतिष्ठदत्यन्तं बाल्यान्न द्रोहचेतसा॥
en: Bhima thus prided himself by tormenting the sons of Dhritarashtra out of boyish pranks. In fact he had no ill will towards them.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीर उत्तीर्य यमुना नदीम्। ती। मधुपुरद्वारि धनुष्पाणिरतिष्ठत॥
en: In the meantime having crossed the river Yamunā, the heroic Satrughna, with bow in his hands, stood at the gate of Madhu's city.

sa: शक्रोपमममित्रघ्नं परवारणवारणम्॥ पश्यन्तः स्त्रीगणास्तत्र वज्रपाणिं स्म मेनिरे। अयं स पुरुषव्याघ्रो रणे वसुपराक्रमः॥ यस्य बाहुबलं प्राप्य न भवन्त्यसुहृद्गणाः।
en: They knew that king to be the destroyer of foes like Indra; they thought him to be the wielder of thunder-bolt himself. They said, “This is that best of heroic men who is as powerful in the battle as the Vasu. All enemies are destroyed by his great prowess.

sa: कच्चिद् दुर्गाणि सर्वाणि धनधान्यायुधोदकैः। यन्त्रैश्च परिपूर्णानि तथा शिल्पिधनुर्धरैः॥
en: Are all your forts always kept filled with treasure, food, weapons, water, engines, and instruments, and are they protected by artisans and bowmen?

sa: कच्चिदस्त्राणि सर्वाणि ब्रह्मदण्डश्च तेऽनघ। विषयोगास्तथा सर्वे विदिताः शत्रुनाशनाः॥
en: O sinless one, are you acquainted with all Weapons all mysterious incantations and with all the secrets of poison destructive of all enemies?

sa: स देशः परराष्ट्राणि विमृज्याभिप्रवर्धितः। भीष्मेण विहितं राष्ट्र धर्मचक्रमवर्तत॥
en: The wheel of virtue being thus set in motion by Bhishma, the country was full of increased population, people coming from other countries.

sa: ततः षोडशवर्षाणि स्थास्यत्यमरसत्तमाः। अस्य षोडशवर्षस्य स संग्रामो भविष्यति॥
en: O best of immortals, let him remain on earth only for sixteen years. On his sixteenth year, will take place that great fight.

sa: स तैः परिवृतः सर्वैर्विष्वगंश्वं नराधिपम्। अभ्यगच्छन्महातेजाः पौरवं पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Surrounded by the kings and all the people whom he subjugated, he marched against that best of men, the descendant of Puru, Vishvagashva.

sa: दुष्करं कृतवान्रामः समुद्रे सेतुबन्धनम्। अश्रुतं पूर्वकैः केश्चिद्देवैरपि सदानवैः॥
en: Indeed Rāma has accomplished a wonderfully hard work; our ancestors, the celestials, the Dānavas none heard of constructing a bridge over the ocean?

sa: शापायाहत्वमापन्ना ब्राह्मणस्य तपस्विनः। प्रभासतीर्थे पार्थेन कृष्णस्य च समागमः॥
en: Who had become alligators by the curse of an ascetic Brahmana; the meeting of Arjuna and Krishna at the holy pilgrimage of Prabhasa;

sa: पाण्डुरुवाच यदि व्यवसितं ह्येतद् युवयोधर्मसंहितम्। स्ववृत्तिमनुवर्तिष्ये तामहं पितुरव्ययाम्॥
en: Pandu said: If your this determination be conformable to virtue, then I shall with you both follow the imperishable path of my father.

sa: ततः सर्वां महीं जेतुमारब्धावुग्रशासनौ। सैनिकांश्च समाहूय सुतीक्ष्णं वाक्यमूचतुः॥ राजर्षयो महायज्ञैर्हव्यकव्यैर्द्विजातयः। तेजो बलं च देवानां वर्धयन्ति श्रियं तथा॥
en: Being desirous of subjugating the whole earth, those two greatly irresistible heroes, summoning their soldiers, spoke these cruel words, “The royal sages with the help of the Brahmanas increase the strength and prosperity of the celestials by pouring libations on the fire and offering other foods in grand sacrifices.

sa: विप्रचित्तिरितिख्यातो य आसीद्दानवर्षभः। जरासन्ध इति ख्यातः स आसीन्मनुजर्षभः॥
en: The best of the Danavas, who was known by the name of Viprachitti, became that best of men who is known as Jarasandha.

sa: तन्महोदधिवत् पूर्णं नगरं वै व्यरोचत। द्वारतोरणनिर्दूहैर्युक्तमध्चयोपमैः॥ प्रासादशतसम्बाधं महेन्द्रपुरसंनिभम्। नदीषु वनखण्डेषु वापीपल्वलसानुषु। काननेषु च रम्येषु विजहर्मुदिता जनाः॥
en: The holy city (Hastinapur) like the wide ocean, full of hundreds of palaces and mansions, possessing gates and arches and looking like dark clouds, appeared like the celestial capital of Indra. The people sported in great delight in the rivers, lakes, tanks, beautiful groves and woods.

sa: तत्रोपकरणं गृह्य नरः कश्चिद् यदृच्छया। राजन्ननुजगामैकः श्वानमादाय पाण्डवान्॥
en: O king, a servant followed the Pandavas at his ease with the necessary things (for the hunt) and took a dog with him.

sa: मन्दप्राणगतिर्धीमान् कृच्छ्रादिव समुद्वहन्। पदातिः स महीपालो जीर्णो गजपतिर्यथा॥
en: With weakened strength and slow motion, that highly intelligent king walked with difficulty, like the leader, exhausted with age, of an elephantine herd.

sa: सम्प्रदध्यौ तथा राजन्नग्नावग्निरिवाहितः। दह्यमानेन मनसा शापं श्रुत्वा तथाविधम्॥
en: Indeed, he began to burn like a fire placed in the midst of another fire. Hearing that curse, his mind burnt with grief.

sa: त्यक्ता वयं तु भवता दुःखशोकपरायणाः। भविष्यामश्चिरं राजन् भवद्गुणशतैर्युताः॥
en: Left by you, O king, we shall have to pass our days in grief and sorrow, remembering hundreds of virtues possessed by you.

sa: आत्मानं मन्यसे चाथ पापकर्माणमन्ततः। शृणु तत्र यथापापमपकृष्येत भारत॥
en: You consider yourself as having perpetrated impious deeds. Do you therefore, O Bharata, listen to the way in which sins, may be removed.

sa: ततः संजायते रूपं ततः स्पर्शोऽभिजायते। ततः संजायते शब्दः संशयस्तत्र जायते। ततः संजायते निष्ठा जन्मैतत् सप्तधा विदुः॥
en: From that is produced smell, from that is produced taste, from that is produced colour, and from that is produced touch; from that is produced sound; from that originates doubt; and from that is produce a resolution. Thus is what is known as the sevenfold creation.

sa: ते च सर्वे द्विजश्रेष्ठा विष्टरेषु समन्ततः। द्वैपायनाभ्यनुज्ञाता निषेदुर्विपुलौजसः॥
en: After Vyasa had been seated, all those foremost of twice-born persons, gifted with profuse energy, sat themselves down, with the permission of Krishna-Dvaipayana.

sa: कृतमादिर्युगानां च सर्वेषां नात्र संशयः। हिरण्यं सर्वरत्नामोषधीनां यवास्तथा॥
en: The Krita is the first of all the cycles; there is no doubt in this. Gold is the first of all precious things.

sa: शतक्रतु उवाच अयं सुतस्ते द्विजमुख्य नाग आगच्छति त्वामभिवीक्षमाणः। पादौ च ते नासिकयोपजिघ्रते श्रेयो ममाध्याहि नमश्च तेऽस्तु॥
en: The god of a hundred sacrifices said This elephant that has been a son, to you, O foremost of Brahmanas, comes to you loO king wistfully at you. See, it smells your feet with its nostrils. My salutations to you. Do you pray for my wellbeing.

sa: शक्र उवाच त्वमेवान्यान् दहसे जातवेदो न हि त्वदन्यो विद्यते भस्मकर्ता। त्वत्संस्पर्शात् सर्वलोको बिभेति अश्रद्धेयं वदसे हव्यवाह॥
en: Shakra said Jataveda, it is you who burns all other things and there is none else who can reduce you to ashes; all the world is afraid to come in contact with you, O carrier of oblation, these words of yours are worthy of no credence.

sa: तमो मोहो महामोहस्तामिस्रः क्रोधसंज्ञितः। मरणं त्वन्धतामिस्रस्तामिस्रः क्रोध उच्यते॥
en: Ignorance, delusion, the great delusion, the great obscurity called anger, and death, that blinding obscurity. As regards anger, that is the great obscurity.

sa: ऋषयः पितरो देवा महाभूतानि धातवः। जङ्गमाजङ्गमं चेदं जगन्नारायणोद्भवम्॥
en: The Rishis, the manes, the celestials, the great (Primal) elements, the metals, indeed, the entire inobile and immobile universe, has originated from Narayana.

sa: आनर्तानवलोक्य त्वं पितरं च महाभुज। वृष्णीश्च पुनरागच्छेर्हयमेधे ममानघ॥
en: Having seen the Anaritas, and your father, O mighty-armed one, and the Vrishnis, you will return to my horse sacrifice, O sinless one!

sa: एवमेतत् तडागस्य कीर्तितं फलमुत्तमम्। अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि वृक्षाणामवरोपणम्॥
en: Thus have the Rishis described the high merits of the excavation of tanks, I shall now describe to you the planting of trees.

sa: इत्युक्तः सहभार्यस्तु सोऽभ्यगच्छन्महामुनिम्॥ शिरसा वन्दनीयं तमवन्दत च पार्थिवः।
en: Thus addressed, the king and the queen approached the great ascetic, and bending their heads they adored him who were worthy of adoration.

sa: अप्सु वृत्रगृहीतासु रसे च विषये हते।॥ शतक्रतुरतिक्रुद्धस्तत्र वज्रमवासृजत्।
en: The waters being seized by Vritra, their liquid property left them. At this Indra became wroth and again smote him with his thunderbolt.

sa: तौ प्रविश्य महात्मानौ तद् गृहं परमार्चितम्। धर्मराजं ददृशतुर्देवराजमिवाश्विनौ॥
en: The two great ones, entering that welladorned chamber, saw king Yudhishthira the just like the two Ashvins seeing the chief of the celestials.

sa: जननी च किमर्थं ते रणभूमिमुपागता। नागेन्द्रदुहिता चेयमुलूपी किमिहागता॥
en: Why has your mother come to the field of battle? Why, also has Ulupi the daughter of the Prince of Snakes, come here?

sa: वृषादर्भिप्रयुक्ता तु कृत्या विकृतदर्शना। यातुधानीति विख्याता पद्मिनी तामरक्षत॥
en: Urged by Vrishadarbhi, the Rakshasi of dreadful appearance who had originated from his incantations and who had been named Yatudhani, guarded the lake.

sa: योऽप्यन्यः कारयेदेवं शरणागतरक्षणम्। सोऽपि गच्छेत तामेव गतिं भरतसत्तमा॥
en: Anybody who would protect in the same way a seeker for protection, would certainly acquire the same happy end, best of the Bharatas.

sa: प्रणीतमृषिभिर्ज्ञात्वा धर्मं शाश्वतमव्ययम्। लुप्यमानं स्वधर्मेण क्षत्रियो ह्येष रक्षिति॥
en: Following the ordinances laid down by the Rishis, the Kshatriyas should adore the Brahmanas according to due rites. This is the eternal usage.

sa: देवदुन्दुभिनादश्च पुष्पवर्षेः सहाभवत्॥ सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव साधु साध्विति हर्षिताः।
en: The celestial kettledrums began to play and floral showers were rained down. The Siddhas and regenerate Rishis, filled with delight, exclaimed, Excellent, Excellent.

sa: अमृष्यमाणास्ते योधा नृपस्य शकुनेर्वधम्॥ अभ्ययुः सहिताः पार्थं प्रगृहीतशरासनाः।
en: Unable to bear, and, therefore, burning to avenge, the destruction of their kin Shakuni. those warriors, armed with bows, rushed together at Partha.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। गृहीत्वा रक्षसा मुक्तो द्विजाति: कानेन यथा॥
en: Regarding it is cited the ancient narrative of how a Brahmana who had been seized in the forest by a Rakshasa, was freed.

sa: पिण्डारक उपस्पृश्य एकरात्रोषितो नरः। अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति प्रभातां शर्वरी शुचिः॥
en: Fasting for one night and bathing in Pindaraka, one becomes purified on the next day and acquires the merit of an agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: अभिषूय ततो राजन् सोमं सोमपसत्तमाः। सवनान्यानुपूर्येण चक्रुः शास्त्रानुसारिणः॥
en: Those foremost of Soma-Drinkers, O monarch, extracting the juice of the Soma, then performed the Savana rite, following the injunctions of the scriptures.

sa: स ह्येषां वृत्तिदाता स्यात् स चैतान् प्रतिपालयेत्। कनिष्ठास्तं नमस्येरन् सर्वे छन्दानुवर्तिनः॥ तमेव चोपजीवरेन् यथैव पितरं तथा।
en: It is the eldest brother who should assign to them their means of support and protect and maintain them. All the younger brothers should bow to him and obey his command. Indeed, they should depend upon him, as they did upon their father during his lifetime.

sa: ततस्तौ रथमास्थाय प्रयातौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ। विकुर्वाणौ कथाश्चित्राः प्रीयमाणौ विशाम्पते॥
en: Then those two friends, viz., Krishna and the son of Pandu, ascended their car and proceeded on the journey, engaged in delightful conversation.

sa: ततः स प्राविशत् तूर्णं जन्मवेश्म पितुस्तवा अर्चि पुरुषव्याघ्र सितैर्माल्यैर्यथाविधि॥ अपां कुम्भैः सुपूर्णश्च विन्यस्तैः सर्वतोदिशम्। घृतेन तिन्दुकालातैः सर्षपैश्च महाभुज॥ अस्त्रैश्च विमलैर्व्यस्तैः पावकैश्च समन्ततः। वृद्धाभिश्चापि रामाभिः परिचारार्थमावृतम्॥
en: He then quickly entered the lying in-room in which your father was born. It was duly sanctificd, O king, with many garlands, of while flowers; with many well-filled waterpots arranged on every side; with char-coal, soaked in clarified butter of Tinduka-wood, and mustard-seeds, o you of mighty arms; with shining weapons properly arranged and several fires on every side. And it was filled with many agreeable and aged dames summoned for waiting.

sa: प्रदक्षिणमथावृत्य राजानं पाण्डवास्तदा। अभिवाद्य न्यवर्तन्त पृथां तामनिवर्त्य वै॥
en: The Pandavas then went round the king and saluted him duly. They ccased to follow further, having failed to persuade Pritha to return.

sa: दृष्ट्वा त्वादित्यमुद्यन्तं कुचराणां भयं भवेत्। अध्वगाः परितप्येयुरुष्णतो दुःखभागिनः॥
en: Seeing the Sun rising, men of evil deeds become filled with fear. Travellers on their way become afflicted with heat, and suffer distress.

sa: पूर्वमेव स बाणौधैर्गाढविद्धोऽर्जुनेन ह। पपात सोऽपि धरणीमालिङ्ग्य रणमूर्धनि॥
en: He had been pierced deeply by Arjuna with clouds of arrows. He, therefore dropped down at the van of battle embracing the Earth.

sa: न प्रकाशन्त वेश्मानि धूमरुद्धानि भारत। निहारसंवृतानीव वनानि गिरयस्तथा॥
en: Covered by that smoke, the places could no longer be seen, O Bharata. These resembled forests and hills overwhelmed by a thick frost.

sa: व्यतीतायां तु शर्वर्यां कृतपौर्वाह्निकक्रियः। भ्रातृभिः सहितो राजा ददर्शाश्रममण्डलम्॥
en: After the night had passed away, king Yudhishthira, having performed his morning rites proceeded to survey that'hermitage in the company of his brothers.

sa: एवं खलु समायुक्तो रमते विगतज्वरः। रूपवान् कीर्तिमांश्चैव धनवांश्चोपपद्यते॥
en: Gifted with such merit, he sports in happiness, freed from every anxiety, possessed of personal beauty and great fame and endued with wealth.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। सुभगे सप्तहोतॄणां विधानमिह यादृशम्॥
en: The Brahmana said Regarding it is cited the ancient story, O blessed one, of what the institution is of the seven sacrificing priests.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच नाहं तथा भीरु चरामि लोके यथा त्वं मां तर्जयसे स्वबुद्ध्या। विप्रोऽस्मि मुक्तोऽस्मि वनेचरोऽस्मि गृहस्थधर्मा व्रतवांस्तथास्मि॥
en: The Brahmana said I do not, O timid one, move in this world in the manner which you, according to your own understanding, censure. I am a Brahmana endued with Vedic knowledge. I am liberated. I am a hermit, I follow the duties of a houscholder. I observe vows.

sa: जेपुश्च शतरुद्रीयं देवाः कृत्वाञ्जलिं तदा। संस्तूयमानस्त्रिदशैः प्रससाद महेश्वरः॥
en: Joining their hands in respect, they began to recite the Shata Rudriya Mantras. Thus lauded by the celestials, at last Maheshvara became gratified.

sa: तमोगुणा बहुविधाः प्रकीर्तिता यथावदुक्तं च तमः परावरम्। नरो हि यो वेद गुणानिमान् सदा स तामसैः सर्वगुणैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: The qualities of Ignorance have been declared to you in various ways. Duly has Ignorance, in its higher and lower forms, been described to you. That man who always bears in mind the qualities mentioned here will surely succeed in becoming freed from all marks which belong to Ignorance.

sa: शाखामासज्य तस्यैव कृष्णाजिनमरिंदम। पातयामास बिल्वानि तदा स द्विजपुङ्गवः॥
en: Causing his deer-skin, O chastiser of enemies, to hang on a branch, that foremost of twice-born ones, then began to pluck some fruits.

sa: तदेतदुत्तमं धर्ममहिंसाधर्मलक्षणम्। ये चरन्ति महात्मानो नाकपृष्ठे वसन्ति ते॥
en: Those great men who practise this excellent Religion which is marked out by abstention from injury, succeed in living in the celestial region.

sa: तत्र युद्धकथाश्चित्राः परिक्लेशांश्च पार्थिव। कथायोगे कथायोगे कथयामासतुः सदा॥
en: And there, O prince, they passed their time in describing the stirring incidents of the war, and the sufferings of their past lives.

sa: पिपीलकस्तु मासांस्त्रीन् कीट:स्यान्मासमेव तु। एतानासाद्य संसारान् कृमियोनौ प्रजायते॥ तत्र जीवति मासांस्तु कृमियोनौ चतुर्दश। ततोऽधर्मक्षयं कृत्वा पुनर्जायति मानवः॥
en: He is next born as an ant, for three months and then as a worm for a month. Having undergone these births, he has next to live as a vile worm for fourteen years. When his sin becomes exhausted by such punishment, he at last regains the human form.
