sa: ततश्चिन्तामनुप्राप्त: कतमदैवतं तु तत्। यन्मे दुतं प्रसीदेत मानुषैरजडीकृतम्॥
en: He thereupon began to think aside, What is that god, hitherto not worshipped by men, who may be forthwith favourably disposed towards me?

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। यथा मृत्युर्गृहस्थेन धर्ममाश्रित्य निर्जितः॥
en: Bhishma said This ancient history is narrated describing the subject of the conquest, by a householder, of Death, by the practice of virtue.

sa: तं धर्ममसुरास्तात नामृष्यन्त जनाधिप। विवर्धमानाः क्रमशस्तत्र तेऽन्वाविशन् प्रजाः॥
en: The Asuras, however, O child, could not bear that virtue, which prevailed in the world. Multiplying the Asuras entered the bodies of inen.

sa: जङ्गमानामसंख्येयाः स्थावराणां च जातयः। तेषां विविधवर्णानां कुतो वर्णविनिश्चयः॥
en: Mobile objects are endless in number; the immobile objects are also innumerable. How then can so many different objects be divided into classes?

sa: ततः पद्मोद्भवो राजन् देवदेवः पितामहः। उवाच मधुरं वाक्यमर्थवद्धेतुभूषितम्॥
en: Then, O king, the great god Brahman, who had originated from the primeval lotus. answered him in these sweet and wellreasoned pregnant words.

sa: यस्य रूपाण्यनेकानि प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः। स्थानानि च विचित्राणि प्रसादाश्चाप्यनेकशः॥
en: Wise men say that his forms are manifold. Many are the places in which he lives. Many are the forms of his Grace.

sa: पश्यमानस्तदाऽऽत्मानमसमं मातरिश्वना। नारदे यन्मया प्रोक्तं वचनं प्रति तन्मृषा॥
en: All that I said to Narada is untrue. I am, forsooth, inferior in power to the Wind. Verily, he is superior in strength.

sa: ये चैनं प्रतिपद्यन्ते भक्तियोगेन भाविताः। तेषामेवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं दर्शयत्येष हृच्छयः॥
en: O you living in all heart you appear before those persons who succeed in attaining to you after having purified themselves by devotion.

sa: अतुष्टिः परितापश्च शोको लोभस्तथाक्षमा। लिङ्गानि रजसस्तानि दृश्यन्ते हेत्वहेतुतः॥
en: Discontent, regret, grief, cupidity, and vindictiveness, having no cause or occasioned by any perceptible cause, are the marks of the quality of Darkness.

sa: उत्तरः पृथिवीभाग: सर्वपुण्यतमः शुभः। इहस्थास्तत्र जायन्ते ये वै पुण्यकृतो जनाः॥ असत्कर्माणि कुर्वन्तस्तिर्यग्योनिषु चापरे। क्षीणायुषस्तथा चान्ये नश्यन्ति पृथिवीतले॥
en: The northern port of the Earth is highly auspicious and sacred. People of our region who perform fair deeds or show regard for Yoga, are born in that region. Others are born in the intermediate species. Some again, when their lease of life run out, become lost on Earth.

sa: वै नूनं पुरैतद् विदितं युवयोर्भावितात्मनोः। पुत्राश्च पितरश्चैव परस्परमपूजयन्॥
en: Forsooth, what the gods did on that occasion is well known to you two. Sons and fathers had thus to adore each other.

sa: पितृवंशमिमं पश्य त्वत्कृते नरकं गतम्। निरर्थाः सर्व एवैषामाशाबन्धास्त्वदाश्रयाः॥
en: See all your ancestors have fallen into hell for your acts. All the hopes your fathers had placed upon you have been frustrated,

sa: जनकोऽप्युत्स्मयन् राजा भावमस्या विशेषयन्। प्रतिजग्राह भावेन भावमस्या नृपोत्तम॥
en: Own Priding himself upon his invincibleness and defeating the intentions of Sulabha, that best of kings seized her resolution with his own resolution.

sa: सर्वे देवा मर्त्यसंज्ञाविशिष्टाः सर्वे मर्त्या देवसंज्ञाविशिष्टाः। तस्मात् पुत्रं मा शुचो राजसिंह पुत्रः स्वर्ग प्राप्य ते मोदते ह॥
en: The gods, without any exception, have to take birth as mortal creatures on Earth. Likewise, all mortal creatures also, succeed in acquiring the dignity to gods. Therefore, O foremost of kings, do not grieve for you son. Your son has gone to heaven, and is enjoying great happiness there.

sa: निर्विकारमृर्षि चापि काष्ठकुड्योपमं तदा॥ दुःखिता प्रेक्ष्य संजल्पमकार्षीदृषिणा सह।
en: Seeing the Rishi quite unmoved and as inanimate as a piece of wood, she became very sorry and began to converse with him.

sa: प्रमथानां गणैश्चैव समन्तात् परिवारितम्। शरदीव सुदुष्प्रेक्ष्यं परिविष्टं दिवाकरम्॥
en: Surrounded by various clans of spirits and ghosts, he appeared like the autumnal Sun difficult of being looked at for its dazzling brightness.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच त्वयैव कथितं पूर्वं सम्भवे द्विजसत्तम। वसिष्ठस्य सुतः शक्तिः शक्तिपुत्रः पराशरः॥ पराशरस्य दायादः कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः।
en: Janamejaya said, O best of twice-born ones, it was you who said before this that the Rishi Vashishtha had a son named Shakti and that Shakti had a son named Parashara, and that Parashara begot a son named the Island-born Krishna gifted with great ascetic merit.

sa: आक्रीडानां गृहाणां च गदानामगदस्य च। प्रज्ञावन्तः प्रयोक्तारो ज्ञानवद्भिरनुष्ठिताः॥
en: They also look to the laying of pleasuregardens, the construction of spacious palaces and the preparation of medicines for all sorts of diseases.

sa: शैलांश्च विविधाकारान् काञ्चनान् रत्नभूषितान्। मणिभूमौ निविष्टाश्च पुष्करिण्यस्तथैव च॥
en: The Rishi saw also many golden hills decked with gems and possessed of various forms. There he saw many lakes and tanks also.

sa: वायुभक्षस्ततः पश्चाद् बहून वर्षगणानभूत्। न चास्य क्षीयते प्राणस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Thereafter he passed many years by living upon air only. All this time, however, his strength did not decrease. This seemed highly wonderful.

sa: ब्रह्मण्यदेवो भगवान् प्रीयतां ते सनातनः॥ युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो महाबुद्धिर्जनार्दनः।
en: Let the illustrious and Eternal God of the Brahmanas, Viz., Janarddana of great intelligence, be pleased with you, O Yudhisthira of mighty arms.

sa: विचार्य कुण्डधारस्तु मानुष्यं चलमध्रुवम्। तपसे मतिमाधत्त ब्राह्मणस्य युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: Then, thinking upon the fieeting and unreal character of the humanity, Kundadhara set his heart, O Yudhisthira, upon inclining the Brahmana to penances.

sa: उपपत्त्या हि सम्पन्नो यतिभिश्चैव सेव्यते। सततं धर्मशीलैश्च निपुणेनोपलक्षितः॥
en: The Yatis also follow this course of conduct, which is consistent with reasons. The righteous always observe it with eyes having purified vision.

sa: न जात्वकाले कुसुमं कुतः फलं पपात वृक्षात् पवनरितादपि। रसप्रदा: कामदुघाश्च धेवनो न दारुणा वाग् विचचार कस्यचित्॥
en: Not a flower,. what to speak of fruits, dropped untimely from a tree even if the WindGod shook it with force. All the kine began to give sweet milk whenever milked by men and cruel and harsh words were not given vent to by any one.

sa: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्। महाभूतानि भूतानां सर्वेषां प्रभवाप्ययौ॥
en: Earth, Wind, Ether, Water, and Light forming the fifth, are the great elements. These are the origin and the destruction of all creatures.

sa: सृजते हि गुणान् सत्त्वं क्षेत्रज्ञः परिपश्यति। सम्प्रयोगस्तयोरेष सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्भुवः॥
en: The Understanding, as already said, creates the qualities. The Soul simply sees them. This union between the Understanding and the Soul is eternal.

sa: तस्यैवं खिद्यमानस्य धर्मं परममास्थितः। कदाचिदतिथिः प्राप्तो ब्राह्मणः सुसमाहितः॥
en: While troubled with such thoughts, a Brahmana of concentrated soul and observant of every superior religion, came to his house as a guest.

sa: तस्य तत् पूर्वसंरुद्धमात्मनः षष्ठमान्तरम्। स्फुरिष्यति समुद्घान्ता विद्युदम्बुधरे यथा॥
en: The mind, which constitutes the sixth, when thus controlled, tries of flash out like the capricious and fickle lightning playing among the clouds.

sa: सवृक्षौषधिरत्नेयं सहसत्त्ववनाकरा॥ तानिदानीं च पश्यामि यैर्भुक्तेयं पुरा मही।
en: I do not see those kings now that had formerly enjoyed this Earth with her trees, plants, gems, living creatures, waters and mines.

sa: सुखदुःखानि भूतानामजरो जरयत्यसौ। आदित्यो ह्यस्तमभ्येति पुनः पुनरुदेति च॥
en: Rising and setting day after day, the Sun, who is himself undecaying, is perpetually coO king the joys and sorrows of all men.

sa: स तदाभ्यर्च्य दैत्येन्द्रं त्रैलोक्यपतिरीश्वरः। असुरेन्द्रमुपामन्त्र्य जगाम स्वं निवेशनम्॥
en: The king of the three worlds then, having adored the lord of the Daityas, took his leave and proceeded to his own quarter.'

sa: इत्युक्तो दैत्यपतिना शक्रो विस्मयमागमत्। प्रीतिमांश्च तदा राजस्तद्वाक्यं प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: Thus addressed by the king of the Daityas, Shakra became filled with wonder and lauded those words, O king, with a cheerful heart.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अपूर्वोऽप्यथवा विद्वान् सम्बन्धी वा यथा भवेत्। तपस्वी यज्ञशीलो वा कथं पात्र भवेत् तु सः॥
en: Yudhishthira said Why, O grandfather, are these five viz., he who is a stranger, he who is gifted with learning, he who is connected by marriage, he that is endued with penances, and he who is devoted to the performance of sacrifices, considered as proper persons?

sa: भूमि केचित् प्रविविशुः पर्वतानपरे तथा॥ अपरे जग्मुराकाशमपरेऽम्भः समाविशन्।
en: Some entered into the bowels of the Earth; others got into the caves of mountains. Some went upwards; others entered into the sea.

sa: प्रहर्षः प्रीतिरानन्दः सुखं संशान्तचित्तता। कथंचिदभिवर्तन्त इत्येते सात्त्विका गुणाः॥
en: Joy, satisfaction, delight, happiness, tranquillity of heart, these are the properties of the state of Goodness. Man sometimes acquires a portion of them.

sa: स्वकार्यबद्धकक्षौ तौ राजन् गृध्रोऽथ जम्बुकः। क्षुत्पिपासापरिश्रान्तौ शास्त्रमालम्ब्य जल्पतः॥
en: Both of them were deterinined upon accomplishing their respective purposes. Exhausted with hunger and thirst, they thus quarrelled, taking advantage of the scriptures.

sa: प्रससाद किल ब्रह्मा स्वयमेवात्मनाऽऽत्मनि। स्मयमानश्च लोकेशो लोकान् सर्वानवैक्षत॥
en: Indeed, the Self-create by an effort of his will, became pleased. Smiling the lord of all the worlds then looked at the universe.

sa: ध्यात्वा चिरं भीमसुता दमयन्ती शुचिस्मिता। भर्तृशोकपरा दीना विवर्णवदनाभवत्॥१००।
en: Thus thinking for a while, Damayanti of pure smiles, the daughter of Bhima, indulging in grief for her husband and miserable, grew pale-faced.

sa: एषा भागीरथी पुण्या देवगन्धर्वसेविता। वातेरिता पताकेव विराजति नभस्तले॥
en: This sacred Bhagirathi frequented by the celestials and the Gandharvas rolls in like a person in the sky shaken by the gentle breeze.

sa: ततोऽधिवॉधर्मज्ञ समाविश्य तपोवनम्। गुह्यकेशु महाराज मोदते नात्र संशयः॥
en: O virtuous man, than going to the forest of the ascetics called Adhivanga. O great king, one rejoices without doubt among the Guhyakas.

sa: ब्राह्मणार्थे पराक्रान्ता: शुद्धैर्बाणैर्महारथाः। निघ्नन्तो भरतश्रेष्ठ मेध्यान् बहुविधान् मृगान्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, those powerful, great car-warriors killed with pure (nonpoisonous) arrows various kinds of sacrificial animals for the Brahmanas.

sa: नित्यं हि पुरुषव्याघ्रा वन्याहारमरिदमाः। उपाकृत्य उपाहृत्य ब्राह्मणेभ्यो न्यवेदयन्॥
en: Those chastisers of foes, those foremost of men daily killed wild animals and after properly sanctifying them, they offered them to the Brahmanas.

sa: एवमुक्तवा प्रियां भार्यां रूपेणाप्रतिमां भुवि। कलिनापहतज्ञानो नलः प्रातिष्ठदुद्यतः॥
en: Thus speaking unto his dear-loved wife matchless on carih in beauty, king Nala, deprived of his senses by Kali, endeavoured to go away.

sa: उषितो हि महाबाहुरिन्द्रलोके धनंजयः। दिव्यान्यस्त्राण्यवाप्याथ ततः प्रत्यागतो वनम्॥
en: The mighty armed Dhananjaya (Arjuna) had lived in the abode of Indra. Having obtained the celestials weapons, he has returned to the forest.

sa: साङ्गोपनिषदान् वेदाञ्जपन्निव महातपाः। तस्य पुत्रोऽभवदृषेः स तेजस्वी महाद्विजः॥
en: That highly effulgent Brahmana, that great ascetic, took birth as that Rishi's (Agastya's) son, as if uttering the Vedas, Vedangas and the Upanishadas.

sa: तत्रेशानं समभ्यर्च्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति गाणपत्यं च विन्दति॥
en: Worshipping thcre Ishana and fasting for three nights, a man obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice and attains to the state of Ganapatya.

sa: तयोर्भुजविनिष्पेषादुभयोर्बलिनोस्तदा। शब्दः समभवद् घोरो वेणुस्फोटसमो युधि॥ अथैनमाक्षिप्य बलाद् गृह्य मध्ये वृकोदरः। धूनयामास वेगेन वायुश्चण्ड इव दुमम्॥
en: The sounds that rose from those mighty combatants pressing each others hands were fearful. They resembled the sounds of splittering bamboo's. Hurling the Rakshasas down. Vrikodar seized him forcibly by the waist and he then began to shake him, as trees are shaken by the wind.

sa: जनकस्य तु राजर्षेः कूपस्त्रिदशपूजितः। तत्राभिषेकं कृत्वा तु विष्णुलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: There is (another) well sacred to the royal sage Janaka worshipped by the celestials. Bathing there one goes to the region of Vishnu.

sa: तथैव शरवर्षेण गन्धर्वास्ते बलोत्कटाः। पाण्डवानभ्यवर्तन्त पाण्डवाश्च दिवौकसः॥ ततः सुतुमुलं युद्धं गन्धर्वाणां तरस्विनाम्। बभूव भीमवेगानां पाण्डवानां च भारत॥
en: Thus attacked, those greatly powerful Gandharvas then rushed on the Pandavas and showered on them innumerable arrows. The Pandavas also in their turn attacked those dwellers of heaven. O descendant of Bharata, then a very fearful battle was fought between the active and energetic Gandharvas and the impetuous Pandavas.

sa: असिभिः पट्टिशैः शूलैर्गदाभिश्च महाबलाः। सूतपुत्रं जिघांसन्तः समन्तात् पर्यवाकिरन्।॥
en: Those greatly powerful heroes, with the desire of killing that Suta's son, surrounded him on all sides with swords, battle axes and spears.

sa: ततोऽहमग्निं व्यधमं सलिलास्त्रेण सर्वशः। शैलेन च महास्त्रेण वायोर्वेगमधारयम्॥
en: Then I totally destroyed the fire by Salila (watery) weapon; and arrested the fury of the wind by the mighty Shaila (rock) weapon.

sa: आसादितमिदं घोरं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। द्रौपदी परिकर्षद्भिः कोपयद्धिश्च पाण्डवान्॥
en: Having dragged Draupadi (into the Sabha) and thus provoked the Pandavas, your sons have brought upon themselves this terrible, fearful and hair-stirring calamity.

sa: सुशीलाः शुक्लजातीयाः क्षान्ता दान्ताः सुतेजसः। शुचियोन्यन्तरगताः प्रायशः शुभलक्षणाः॥
en: Are well behaved, given to the practice of yoga, of forgiving spirit, self-controlled, energetic, well-born and are endowed with the signs of greatness.

sa: तत उत्थाय राजेन्द्र शाल्वः परमदुर्मनाः। व्यपायात् सबलस्तूर्णं प्रद्युम्नशरपीडितः॥
en: O king of kings, then the mighty Shalva, pierced with the arrows of Pradyumna, rose up disheartened; and he then speedily fled away.

sa: स चापि पापप्रकृतिदैतेयापसदो नृप। मय्यवर्षत दुर्धर्षः शरधाराः सहस्रशः॥
en: O king, that greatly sinful and irrepressibly powerful wretch of a Daitya's son began to shoot at me thousands of arrows in torrents.

sa: ततो बदरिकातीर्थं स्नात्वा भरतसत्तम॥ दीर्घमायुरवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति।
en: O best of the Bharata race, then bathing in the Tirtha called Badarika, one obtains long life and goes to the celestials region.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्येवमुक्ते वचने कृतवैरो दुरात्मवान्। जितमित्येव शकुनियुधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard this and adopting unfair means, Shakuni, ever ready with the dice, said to Yudhishthira, “Lo, I have won?" was

sa: तव दुःखोपपन्नाया यैराचरितमप्रियम्। विद्धि सम्प्रस्थितान् सर्वांस्तान् कृष्णे यमसादनम्॥
en: O Krishna, know that those who do you any injury when you are in distress are already gone to the abode of Yama,

sa: उद्धृत्ता ह्यसुराः केचिन्निवातकवचा इति। विप्रियेषु स्थितास्माकं वरदानेन मोहिताः॥
en: Besides, there are certain Asuras, called Nivatkavachas who, being proud of the boon they have acquired, are (now) engaged in doing us injuries.

sa: दमयन्ती तथा तेन पृच्छ्यमाना विशाम्यते। सर्वमेतद् यथावृत्तमाचचक्षेऽस्य भारत॥
en: O lord of your people! O descendant of Bharata's race! thus questioned by him, Damayanti, related unto him precisely, all that had occurred.

sa: दुमं किम्पुरुषाचार्यमतिक्रम्य तथार्चितः। भीष्मके चैव दुर्धर्षं पाण्डुवत् कृतलक्षणे॥
en: Passing over the preceptor of the Kimpurushas, he (Krishna) has been worshipped by you. When the invincible Bhishmaka, auspicious marked king of Paundrya.

sa: इदं तु त्वां कुरुराजोऽभ्युवाच पूर्वं पृष्ट्वा कुशलं चाव्ययं च। इयं सभा त्वत्सभातुल्यरूपा भ्रातृणां ते दृश्यतामेत्य पुत्र॥
en: The Kuru king has commanded me first to enquire after your peace and prosperity, and then to tell you on his behalf the following. (He says to you), "The Assembly-hall of your cousin (built by me) is equal to your Sabha. Therefore, (come) and see it.

sa: ते जवेन महावेगाः प्लवमाना विहायसा। गन्धमादनमाजग्मुः प्रकर्षन्त इवाम्बरम्॥
en: (And) they (the horses) of great swiftness ranging through the firmament with great speed reached the Gandhamadanas as if drawing forward the sky.

sa: तत्राहूता गताः सर्वे सुनीथप्रमुखा गणाः। समदृश्यन्त संक्रुद्धा विवर्णवदनास्तथा॥
en: The invited kings, who had come to the sacrifice, all with Sunitha (Shishupala) at their head, looked angry, and their face became pale.

sa: ततोऽहं समनुज्ञाता तेन पित्रा च तेऽनघ। तवान्तिकमनुप्राप्ता शुश्रूषितुमरिदम्॥
en: O sinless one, thus commanded by him and also by your father, O chastiser of foes, I have come to wait upon you.

sa: तत्र द्वारमनुप्राप्ता द्वारस्थेश्व निवेदिता। अर्जुनस्य नरश्रेष्ठ उर्वशी शुभलोचना॥
en: O foremost of men, having arrived at the gate (of Arjuna's abode), Urvashi of charming eyes sent words (to Arjuna) through the gatekeeper.

sa: शुशुभे स महाबाहुर्गदाखड्गधनुधरः। निहत्य समरे सर्वान् दानवान् मघवानिव॥
en: And he (Bhima) of mighty arms, armed with mace, sword and bow looked like Maghavana (Indra) having slain all the Danavas in battle.

sa: द्रौपद्या वर्धयन् हर्षं गदामादाय पाण्डवः। व्यपेतभयसम्मोहः शैलराजं समाश्रितः॥
en: And the Pandava devoid of all fear and affliction, proceeded to the mountain furnished with his club to the great delight of Draupadi.

sa: महानद्यामुपस्पृश्य तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः। अक्षयान् प्राप्नुयाल्लोकान् कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: Bathing in the Mahanadi and offering their oblations to the Pitris and the celestials, one obtains eternal region and also saves his race.

sa: पूतनाघातपूर्वाणि कर्माण्यस्य विशेषतः। त्वया कीर्तयतास्माकं भूयः प्रव्यथितं मनः॥
en: You have once again given pains to our hearts by reciting the deeds of this (Krishna), such as his killing Putana and others.

sa: स्मयन्निव गुडाकेशं प्रेक्षमाणः सहस्रदृक्। हर्षेणोत्फुल्लनयनो न चातृप्यत वृत्रहा।॥
en: Seeing the smiling Gudakesha (Arjuna) the thousand-eyed deity, the slayer of Vritra, with his eyes expanded with delight, seemed not to be gratified.

sa: सरांसि सरितश्चैव पर्वतांश्च वनानि च। वृक्षांश्च बहुलच्छायान् ददृशुगिरिमूर्धनि॥
en: On their way they saw many lakes, rivers, mountains, forests with trees of wide spreading shades standing on the summit of the mountains,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच भ्रातुर्वचनमाज्ञाय भीमसेनो घटोत्कचम्। आदिदेश नरव्याघ्रस्तनयं शत्रुकर्शनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard the words of his brother, that foremost of men Bhimasena spoke thus to that chastiser of foes, Ghatotkacha.

sa: एतत् कृत्यतमं राजन्नस्माकं भरतर्षभ। अयं हि शकुनिर्वेद सविद्यामक्षसम्पदम्॥
en: O best of Bharata race, O king, this is our highest duty. This Shakuni is highly proficient in the whole science of dice-playing.

sa: आच्छादयसि प्रावारानश्नासि विशदौदनम्। आजानेया वहन्त्यश्वाः केनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: You wear the best robes, you eat food prepared with meat, you ride the best horses, why then are you pale and emaciated?

sa: उपेतं पापैर्दिव्यैः सदापुष्पफलोपगैः। ददृशुस्तां च बदरी वृत्तस्कन्धां मनोरमाम्॥
en: Adorned with celestials trees bearing fruits and flowers in all seasons of the year. They then saw that charming Badari of large trunk.

sa: स्निग्धामविरलच्छायां श्रिया परमया युताम्। पत्रैः स्निग्धैरविरलैरुपेतां मृदुभिः शुभाम्॥
en: It was full of freshness, of deep shade, of excellent beauty and of thick, soft and green foliage; it was blessed and healthful,

sa: तस्मिन् रथे स्थितं सूतं तप्तहेमविभूषितम्। दृष्ट्वा पार्थो महाबाहुर्देवमेवान्वतर्कयत्॥
en: Beholding seated on that car a charioteer adorned with burning gold, the mighty-armed son of Pritha, considered it as belonging to the celestials.

sa: आर्यशास्त्रातिगे क्रूर लुब्धेधर्मापचायिनि। धार्तराष्ट्र श्रियं दत्त्वाधाता किं फलमश्नुते॥
en: Conferring prosperity prosperity upon the wily avaricious of Dhritarashtra, who transgresses the sacred scriptures and injures virtue, what fruit shall the Creator reap?

sa: कुन्तीमातर्महाबाहो त्वमीशान: पुरातनः। परां सिद्धिमनुप्राप्तः साक्षाद् देवगतिं गतः॥
en: "O mighty-armed son of Kunti, you are the ancient Ishana; you have already attained to the highest success and dignity of a god.

sa: धर्म एव मनः कृष्णे स्वभावाच्चैव मेधृतम्। धमवाणिज्यको हीनो जघन्योधर्मवादिनाम्॥ नधर्मफलमाप्नोति योधर्मं दोग्धुमिच्छति। यश्चैनं शङ्कते कृत्वा नास्तिक्यात् पापचेतनः॥
en: My mind and nature, O Krishna, are naturally bent upon virtue; that vile trader of virtue, the worst of the virtuous, who wishes to reap the fruits of virtue, does never obtain them; nor does a vicious-minded person, for his scepticism, who doubts a virtuous act, having accomplished it.

sa: चमसोद्भेदनं विप्रास्तत्रापि कथयन्त्युत। प्रभासं चोदधौ तीर्थं त्रिदशानां युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O Yudhishthira, the Brahmanas say that on the sea-coast is the Chamasodbhedana and also Prabhasa, the Tirtha which is adored by the celestials.

sa: ततो विनशनं गच्छेनियतो नियताशनः। गच्छत्यन्तर्हिता यत्र मेरुपृष्ठे सरस्वती।१११॥
en: Then one should go with regulated diet and subdued soul to Vinasana, where the Sarasvati, disappeared on the breast of the Meru (mountain).

sa: ततो मुञ्जवटं गच्छेत् स्थानं देवस्यधीमतः॥ अभिगम्य महादेवमभिवाद्य च भारत। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्॥ तस्मिस्तीर्थे तु जाह्नव्यां स्नात्वा पापैः प्रमुच्यते।
en: Then one should go to Munjavata, the region of the intelligent deity (Shiva). O descendant of Bharata, seeing there Mahadeva and worshipping him and also walking round it, one attains to the state of Ganapatya. Bathing in that Tirtha in the Janhavi, one is cleansed of all his sins.

sa: दत्तात्रेयप्रसादेन विमानं काञ्चनं तथा। ऐश्वर्यं सर्वभूतेषु पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते॥
en: O lord of earth, through the favour of Dattatreya he possessed a golden car. His wealth was the whole earth including all creatures.

sa: तस्यां पुर्यां तदा चैव माहिष्मत्यां कुरूद्वह। बभूवुरनतिग्राह्या योषितश्छन्दतः किल॥ एवमग्निर्वरं प्रादात् स्त्रीणामप्रतिवारणे। वरिण्यस्तत्र नार्यो हि यथेष्टं विचरन्त्युत॥
en: O perpetuator of the Kuru race, from that day the girls of the city of Mahishmati became rather unacceptable to others (as wives). Agni by his boon granted them sexual liberty. The women of that city, being not confined to a particular husband, always roamed as Sairini at will.

sa: यत्र पुण्यतरं तीर्थं प्लक्षावतरणं शुभम्। यत्र सारस्वतैरिष्टवा गच्छन्त्यवभृथैर्द्विजाः॥
en: And here is also the very sacred and auspicious Tirtha called Plakshavatarana where the Brahmanas after performing the Sarasvati sacrifice made their ablutions.

sa: तत्र नानाविधानग्नीन् प्रवक्ष्यामि महाप्रभान्। कर्मभिर्बहुभिः ख्यातान् नानार्थान् ब्राह्मणेष्विह॥
en: I shall (now) describe to you various sorts of fire of great effulgence which are known to the Brahmanas by their respective names.

sa: महागज इवास्रावी प्रभञ्जन् विविधान् दुमान्। उत्पाट्य कदलीस्तम्भान् बहुतालसमुच्छ्यान्॥
en: Like a large elephant breaking many trees and uprooting innumerable plantain trees as high as many palm trees put one upon the other.

sa: त्रयोदश समा राजन्नुत्पातानां फलं महत्। सर्वक्षत्रविनाशाय भविष्यति विशाम्पते॥
en: "O king, for thirteen years those portents will produce great results. O king, they may even cause the destruction of all the Kshatriyas.

sa: अथोपविश्य भगवान् काञ्चने परमासने। आस्तामिति चोवाच धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: When the illustrious (Rishi) took his seat on a best seat made of gold, he said to Dharmaraja Yudhishthira "to take his seat".

sa: स्वराष्ट्राणि गमिष्यामस्तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि। श्रुत्वा तु वचनं राज्ञां धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: We now desire to return to our own kingdoms. You should give us permission”. Having heard the words of the kings, Dharmaraja Yudhishthira.

sa: वर्जयन्ति च राजानस्तत् पुरं भरतर्षभ। भयादग्नेर्महाराज तदाप्रभृति सर्वदा॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O great king, from that day all the kings avoid this city for the fear of fire.

sa: राजा च धृतराष्ट्रस्तु पुत्राणामनयं तदा। ध्यायन्नुद्विग्नहृदयो न शान्तिमधिजग्मिवान्॥
en: King Dhritarashtra, thinking of the dangers that threatened his sons, became a prey to anxiety and could not get any peace of mind.

sa: एष तिष्ठति गाविन्दः पूजितोऽस्माभिरच्युतः। यस्य वस्त्वरते बुद्धिर्मरणाय स माधवम्॥ कृष्णमाह्वयतामद्य युद्धे चक्रगदाधरम्। यादवस्यैव देवस्य देहं विशतु पातितः॥
en: Here is Govinda (Krishna) who knows no deterioration. Him have we worshipped. Let him, who is willing to meet a speedy death call today to battle Madhava, Krishna, the wielder of discus and club, falling (in the battle), let him enter and mix with the body of this Deity.

sa: ऋषिभिः सम्परित्यक्ता धर्मयुक्ता महाव्रताः। द्रुतमागम्य चोचुस्ता देवसेनापतिं प्रभुम्॥
en: Those virtuous and vow-observing ones, having been abandoned by the Rishis, came to the celestial and exalted generallisimo and spoke to him thus.

sa: अथ दाशरथिर्वीरो रामो नाम महाबलः। विष्णुर्मानुषरूपेण चचार वसुधातमल्॥
en: Once upon a time, the greatly powerful son of Dasharatha by name Rama who was Vishnu in human form wandered over the earth.

sa: स पितुः प्रियमन्विच्छन् सहभार्यः सहानुजः। सधनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठो दण्डकारण्यमाश्रितः॥
en: In order to please his father, he with his wife and brother, armed with the best of bows, resided in the Dandaka forest.

sa: अथैनं स्मयमानं तु स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषिणी। दमयन्ती नलं वीरमभ्यभाषत विस्मिता॥
en: Filled as she was with amazement, yet Damayanti, smilingly addressed the heroic Nala, who, also gently smiled at her. She smilingly said thus.

sa: गात्रसंस्पर्शसम्बद्धां त्र्यम्बकेण सहानघ। पार्थस्य देवदेवेन शृणु सम्य समागमम्॥
en: O sinless, one, hear in detail the account of Partha's meting with the three-eyed, god of gods and his contact with his body.

sa: बाहू विशालौ कृत्वासौ तेन भीमोऽपि गच्छति। बाहू विदर्शयन् राजन् बाहुद्रविणदर्पितः॥ चिकीर्षन् कर्म शत्रुभ्यो बाहुद्रव्यानुरूपतः। प्रदिशञ्छरसम्पातान् कुन्तीपुत्रोऽर्जुनस्तदा॥
en: O king Bhima ever proud of his strength of arms, goes repeatedly stretching forth his mighty arms and exhibiting them and desiring to do to his enemies, deeds worthy of those arms. The son of Kunti, Arjuna, capable of using both his arms (in throwing weapon),

sa: तस्य वर्षशतं संधिः संध्यांशश्च ततः परम्। संधिसंध्यांशयोस्तुल्यं प्रमाणमुपधारय॥
en: Its morning and evening comprise one hundred years. Know that the duration of the morning and evening (of a Yuga) is the same.

sa: ब्रह्मवध्यानुलिप्तानां तथा मिथ्याभिशंसिनाम्। नृपाणां पृथिवीपाल प्रतिगृहणन्ति वै द्विजाः॥
en: O ruler of earth, the Brahmanas, polluted with the sin of killing the twice-born, accept gifts from kings who are addicted to falsehood.

sa: सप्तवर्षाष्टवर्षाश्च स्त्रियो गर्भधरा नृप। दशद्वादशवर्षाणां पुंसां पुत्रः प्रजायते॥
en: O king, girls of seven and eight years of age, give birth to children and boys of ten or twelve years beget offspring.

sa: वीरपल्यस्तथा नार्यः संश्रयन्ति नरान् नृप। भर्तारमपि जीवन्तमन्यान् व्यभिचरन्त्युत॥
en: O king, even women who are the wives of good men forget themselves with others even at the life time of their husbands.

sa: एतद् वः सर्वमाख्यातं तस्माच्छीघ्रं विधीयताम्। एवमुक्तास्ततो देवा अनुज्ञाप्य पितामहम्॥ नारायणं पुरस्कृत्य दधीचस्याश्रमं ययुः। सरस्वत्याः परे पारे नानादुमलतावृतम्॥
en: I have told you all. Do all this without delay." Having been thus addressed, the celestials bidding farewell to the Grandsire (Brahima). Went to the hermitage of Dadhichi with Narada at their head. It (hermitage) stood on the opposite bank of the Sarasvati, covered with various plants and creepers.

sa: संक्रुद्धाः सम्प्रधावन्त अश्वग्रहणकाक्षिणः। ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज कपिलो मुनिसत्तमः॥
en: Being eager to get the horse, they ran towards it in anger. O great king, thereupon that foremost of Rishis, Kapila, grew angry.

sa: द्वारपाल उवाच कथं यज्ञं दशवर्षो विशेस्त्वं विनीतानां विदुषां सम्प्रवेशम्। उपायतः प्रयतिष्ये तवाहं प्रवेशने कुरु यत्नं यथावत्॥
en: The gate-keeper said : How can you, who are but in your tenth year, hope to enter into the grounds of this sacrifice into which only learned and educated men are admitted? I shall however try some means to admit you. You too make an attempt.

sa: ततः प्रविष्टस्तत्कुक्षिं सहसा मनुजाधिप। सराष्ट्रनगराकीर्णां कृत्स्नां पश्यामि मेदिनीम्॥
en: O ruler of men, thus suddenly entering his stomach, I beheld the whole earth (there within it) with all its cities and kingdoms.

sa: ततः परीक्षामश्वानां चक्रे राजन् स बाहुकः। अश्वशालामुपागम्य भागासुरिनृपाज्ञया॥
en: O king, thereupon Bahuka went, at the behest of the royal son of Vangasura, to the stables; and there he examined the horses.

sa: तथोक्ता ब्रह्मकन्येति लक्ष्मीर्वृत्तिः सरस्वती। दण्डनीतिर्जगद्धात्री दण्डो हि बहुविग्रहः॥
en: His wife Morality passes by the names of Brahman's daughter, Lakshmi, Vritti, Sarasvati, and Mother of the universe. Punishment has thus many forms.

sa: स कदाचित् समुद्रान्ते विचरन्नाश्रमान्तिके। एकः खड्गधनुष्पाणिः परिचक्राम सूर्यजः॥
en: One day he walked on the sea shore by the side of that hermitage. Armed with bow and sword, Surya's son wandered alone.

sa: तथैव तव पुत्रोऽपि गदामार्गविशारदः। व्यचरल्लघु चित्रं च भीमसेनजिघांसया॥
en: Likewise your son O king, who was an adept in the mace fight, moved about beautifully and with great activity, for killing Bhimasena.

sa: तव प्रसादाद् गोविन्द राज्यं निहतकण्टकम्। अप्राप्यं मनसापीदं प्राप्तमस्माभिरच्युत॥ प्रत्यक्षं मे महाबाहो संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे। विमर्दः सुमहान् प्राप्तस्त्वया यादवनन्दन॥
en: Through your kindness, O Govinda, my kingdom has been freed from pests. We have gained now what we could not even imagine. Omighty-armed one, in battle, making the very hair to stand on end, thou hadst to bear voilent blows before my very eyes, O delighter of the Yadavas.

sa: श्रीसमृद्धं तदा दृष्ट्वा नारदं देवरूपिणम्। सुकुमारी प्रदुद्राव परपत्यभिशङ्कया।॥
en: Seeing her husband possessed of celestial forin shining with beauty, Sukumari fled from him taking him, to be somebody other than her husband.

sa: हतास्ते क्षत्रधर्मेण ज्ञातयस्तव पार्थिव। स्वर्गताश्च महात्मानो वीराः क्षत्रियपुङ्गवाः॥
en: Your kinsinen, O king, have all died while perforining the Kshatriya duties, Those leading Kshatriyas, those high-souled heroes, have all gone to heaven.

sa: अहो विनिकृतो लोको लोभेन च वशीकृतः। लोभक्रोधभयोन्मत्तो नात्मानमवबुध्यते॥
en: Alas, the world is deceived, and covetousness subdues it. Deprived of sense by covetousness, anger, and fear, one knows not one's own self!

sa: प्रीताश्च देवता नित्यमिन्द्रे परिवदन्त्यपि। अन्नं ददाति शऋचाप्यनुगृह्णन्निमाः प्रजाः॥
en: The gods being gratified, commend the dwellers of the Earth to Indra. For benefiting the inhabitants of the Earth, Indra gives them food.

sa: महाधनुर्मण्डालनिः सृतैः शितैः क्रियाप्रयत्नप्रितैर्बलेन च। विभेद मर्मस्वपि चार्जुनस्त्वरन्॥
en: Arjuna again cut Karna to the quick with many excellent and keen arrows shot off his circling bow with force, care and skill.

sa: व्यालतस्करसंकीर्णे सार्थहीना यथा वने। सूतपुत्रे हते राजंस्तव योधास्तथाभवन्॥
en: After the fall of Karna your warrior behaved like men, having no protector in a forest abounding in beasts of prey and robbers.

sa: शिलाशितेन च विभो क्षुरप्रेण महायशाः॥ शिरश्चिच्छेद सहसा तप्तकुण्डलभूषणम्।
en: With another razor-headed arrow, O lord whetted on stone, that illustrious hero, smiling cut off his antagonist's head crown adorned with a golden.

sa: तं कदाचिददीनात्मा सखा शक्रस्य मानितः। अभ्यगच्छन्महीपालो मान्धाता शत्रुकर्शनः॥
en: One day, that grinder of enemies, that friend of Shakra, viz., king Mandhata of great soul, came to Vasuhoma on his mountain retreat.

sa: सर्वस्याशा सुमहती पुरुषस्योपजायते। तस्यां विहन्यमानायां दुःखो मृत्युर्न संशयः॥
en: Hope is tne sheet-anchor of every man. When that hope is destroyed, great grief follows which, forsooth, is almost equal to death itself.

sa: स तदाज्ञाय दुष्टात्मा पितुर्वचनमप्रियम्। निराश: सर्वकल्याणैः शोकात् पर्यचरन्महीम्॥
en: Hearing those bitter words of his father the wicked Ashvatthaman, giving up all hopes of prosperity, began to wander sorrowfully over the Earth.

sa: पाञ्चाल्यस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः सैन्येन पहाताऽऽवृतः॥ अभ्यद्रवत् सुसंक्रुद्धस्तावकान् हन्तुमुद्यतः।
en: Worked up with rage and supported by a large army, the Panchala prince rushed against your infuriated soldiers from desire of killing them.

sa: ततः शक्त्यस्त्रमददद् भगवान् पाकशासनः॥ गुहाय राजशार्दूल विनाशाय सुरद्विषाम्।
en: The worship chastiser of Paka, ( foremost of kings, conferred on Kartikeya, a dart for the destruction of the enemies of the celestials.

sa: सहस्रमश्वा एकैकं हस्तिनं पृष्ठतोऽन्वयुः। गवां सहस्रमश्वेऽश्वे सहस्रं गव्यजाविकम्॥
en: Behind each elephant were a thousand horses, and behind each horse a thousand kine, and behind each cow a thousand goats and sheep.

sa: कुलस्यास्यान्तकरणं दुर्मतिं पापपूरुषम्॥ राजा राष्ट्रेश्वरं कृत्वा धृतराष्ट्रोऽद्य शोचति।
en: Having installed that wicked prince of sinful acts, that exterminator of his race, as the monarch, King Dhritarashtra is obliged to grieve today.

sa: तथैव सिद्धा राजेन्द्र तथा वातिकचारणाः। नरसिंहौ प्रशंसन्तौ विप्रजग्मुर्यथागतम्॥
en: Similarly the Siddhas and the quickcoursing Charanas went to those places from which they had come, praising these two best of men. Inc

sa: संजीवितश्चापि पुनर्वासवानुमते तदा। भवितव्यं तथा तच्च न तच्छक्यमतोऽन्यथा॥
en: I restored Srinjaya's child to life with Indra's permission. That which is ordained must take place. It is impossible to make it otherwise.

sa: कश्यप उवाच असंत्यागात् पापकृतामपा स्तुल्यो दण्डः स्पृशते मिश्रभावात्। शुष्णा दह्यते मिश्रभार्वा न मिश्रः स्यात् पापकृद्भिः कथंचित्॥
en: By standing aloof from the sinful, one becomes pure and stainless. However, by being mixed with the sinful, the sinless are punished. Wet wood, if mixed with dry wood, is consumed by the fire for such mixture. The sinless, therefore, should never associate with the sinful.

sa: गत्वा चैनमपश्यन्त किञ्चित्प्राणं जनाधिपम्। ततो रथेभ्यः प्रस्कन्द्य परिवस्तवात्मजम्॥
en: Arrived there, they found that life had not been wholly extinct in the king. Getting down from their cars, they encircled you son.

sa: भो भो ब्राह्मण धर्मज्ञ किमर्थं नृत्यते भवान्। हर्षस्थानं किमर्थं च तवेदमधिकं मुने॥ तपस्विनो धर्मपथे स्थितस्य द्विजसत्तम।
en: Why, O Brahmana, do you dance in this way, you who know your duties well? What must be the cause of your joy, O sage, that being an ascetic, ( best of Brahmanas and walking in the path of virtue you should behave in this way?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इङ्गितेनैव दाशार्हस्तमभिप्रायमादितः। द्रौणेर्बुद्ध्वा महाबाहुरर्जुनं प्रत्यभाषत॥ अर्जुनार्जुन यदिव्यमस्त्रं ते हृदि वर्तते। द्रोणोपदिष्टं तस्यायं काल: सम्प्रति पाण्डव॥
en: Vaishampayana said "In the very beginning the powerful hero of Dasharha's, race understood from sings the intention of Drona's son. He said to Arjuna, O son of Pandu, the time is come for the use of that celestial weapon, the use of which was given to you by Drona.

sa: व्यवसायो जयो धर्मः सिद्धिलक्ष्मीधृतिः स्मृतिः। महासेनस्य सैन्यानामग्रे जग्मुर्नराधिप॥
en: Exertion and Victory and Righteousness and Success and Prosperity and Courage and the Scriptures, (in their embodied forms) followed Kartikeya's army, O king.

sa: पूजयेद् धार्मिकान् राजा निगृह्णीयादधार्मिकान्। नियुज्याच्च प्रयत्नेन सर्ववर्णान् स्वकर्मसु॥
en: The king should honour the righteous and punish the unrighteous. He should, acting with resolution, compell the several castes follow their respective duties,

sa: तैरस्तमस्त्रं विनिहत्य सर्वं जघान तेषां रथवाजिनागान्॥ नभ्यर्दयन्मार्गणैः सूतपुत्रः।
en: O monarch! Suta's son thus killed all their horses, cars and elephants and distressed many of their best warriors by his own shafts.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच हीने परमके धर्मे सर्वलोकाभिलचिते। अधर्मे धर्मतां नीते धर्मे चाधर्मतां गते॥ मर्यादासु विनष्टासु क्षुभिते धर्मनिश्चये। राजभिः पीडिते लोके परैर्वापि विशाम्पते॥ सर्वाश्रमेषु मूढेषु कर्मसूपहतेषु च। कामाल्लोभाच्च मोहाच्च भयं पश्यत्सु भारत॥ अविश्वस्तेषु सर्वेषु नित्यं भीतेषु पार्थिव। निकृत्या हन्यमानेषु वञ्चयत्सु परस्परम्॥ सम्प्रदीप्तेषु देशेषु ब्राह्मणे चातिपीडिते। अवर्षति च पर्जन्ये मिथो भेदे समुत्थिते॥ सर्वस्मिन् दस्युसाद् भूते पृथिव्यामुपजीवने। केनस्विद् ब्राह्मणो जीवेज्जघन्ये काल आग
en: Yudhishthira said “When virtue is deteriorated and is transgressed by all, when sin is considered as virtue, and virtue become vice, when all healthy restraints are washed a way, and all truths regarding righteousness are disturbed and confounded, when people are oppressed by kings and robbers, when men of all the four modes of life become stupefied about their duties, and all works are shorn of merit, when men see cause of fear on all sides for lust and covetousness and folly, when all creatures cease to trust one another, when they kill one another by deceitful means and impose upon one another, when houses are consumed throughout the country, when the Brahmanas are greatly assailed, when the clouds do not discharge a drop of rain, when every one's hand is turned against his neighbour, w

sa: स्वधर्मे वर्तमानस्य सापवादेऽपि भारत। एवमात्मपरित्यागस्तव राजन् न शोभनः॥
en: You should follow, O Bharata, the duties, even if reproachable, of your own order. This self-destruction, o king, does not appear in you.

sa: क्रियाभ्युपायैर्बहुभिर्मायामप्सु प्रयोज्य च॥ जहि त्वं भरतश्रेष्ठ मायात्मानं सुयोधनम्।
en: By applying your power of illusion to these waters kill, O chief of the Bharatas, this Suyodhana who is the master of illusion.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु निहते शूरे चक्ररक्षे महारथे। मद्रराजोऽपि बलवान् सैनिकानावृणोच्छरैः॥
en: When that brave and mighty car-warrior, the protector of Shalya's car-wheel, was thus killed, Shalya enshrouded the Pandava warriors with showers of arrows.

sa: अद्य पाञ्चालपाण्डूनां शयितानात्मजान् निशि। खड्डेन निशितेनाजौ प्रमथिष्यामि गौतम
en: I shall to-night, O son of Gotama, strike with my sharp sword, in battle, the sleeping sons of the Panchalas and the Pandavas.

sa: अतः पृथिव्या यन्तारं क्षत्रियं दण्डधारिणम्। द्वितीयं वर्णमकरोत् प्रजानामनुगुप्तये॥
en: Then, for ruling the Earth and holding the rod of punishment and protecting all creatures, the second order, viz., the Kshatriya was created.

sa: यं पृथग्धर्मचरणाः पृथग्धर्मफलैषिणः। पृथग्धः समर्चन्ति तस्मै धर्मात्मने नमः॥
en: Men following various religions moved by desire of various fruits, worship you with various rites. Salutations to you in your form of religion.

sa: ईश्वरः सर्वदेवस्तु राजराजो नराधिपः। सर्वेषामेव रुद्राणां शूलपाणिरिति श्रुतिः॥
en: The Shrutis say that the great god Mahadeva, the lord of lords, O king, armed with Shula, is the lord of the Rudras.

sa: शल्यस्तु शरवर्षेण पीडयामास पाण्डवम्। मद्रराजं तु कौन्तेयः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Then Shalya enshrouded Yudhishthira with showers of arrows. Likewise the son of Kunti covered the king of the Madras with showers of arrows.

sa: तमेनं ब्रह्मणः पुत्रमनुजातं क्षुपं ददौ। प्रजानामधिपं श्रेष्ठं सर्वधर्मभृतामपि॥
en: The rod of punishment was given to Brahmana's latest-born son, viz., Kshupa, the lord of all creatures and the foremost of the virtuous.

sa: स चतुर्भिर्महेष्वासैः पाण्डवानां महारथैः। वृतस्तान् योधयामास मद्राराजः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Though surrounded by those four great bowmen and powerful car-warriors of the Pandavas, the valiant king of the Madras still fought with them.

sa: तोषयित्वा महादेवं पर्वते गन्धमादने। अस्त्राणि वरयामास परशुं चातितेजसम्॥
en: Having satisfied Mahadeva the mountains of Gandhamadana, he begged from that deity for weapons, especially the axe of fierce power in his hands.

sa: माद्रीपुत्रौ तु शकुनिमुलूकं च महारथम्॥ ससैन्यौ सहसैन्यौ तावुपतस्थतुराहवे।
en: The two sons of Madri, accompanied by their soldiers, proceeded against Sakuni and the great car-warrior Uluka at the head of their forces.

sa: उत्कृत्तशिरसश्चान्यान् विजग्धान् मृगपक्षिभिः। दृष्ट्वा काश्चिन्न जानन्ति भर्तृन् भरतयोषितः॥
en: Some amongst the Bharata ladies, beholding the bodies of their husbands, mangled by animals and birds and shorn of heads,-are not recognising them.

sa: नन्दयैतान् महाराज मत्तानिव महाद्विपान्। उपपन्नेन वाक्येन सततं दुःखभागिनः॥
en: O king, cheer up these your brothers, who are like infuriate elephants (in prowess) with proper words,-these heroes who have always suffered miseries!

sa: ससोमस्याभिषवं कृत्वा चकार विपुल ध्वनिम्। चाविशद् दिवं राजन् पुनः शब्दस्त्रितस्य वैः॥ समवाप्य च तं यज्ञ यथोक्तं ब्रह्मावादिभिः।
en: He distributed amongst the celestials their respective shares (of those sacrificial offerings). Having next mentally drunk Soma, he began to inake a great noise. Those sounds, O king, first uttered by the sacrificing Rishi, entered into heaven and Trita performed that sacrifice after the manner laid down by Brahmavadins.

sa: यदैनं पतितं भूमावपश्यं रुधिरोक्षितम्। तदैवाविशदत्युग्रो ज्वरो मां मुनिसत्तम॥
en: O best of sages, when I saw the grandfather stretched on the Earth and bathed in blood, a violent fever afflicted my heart.

sa: अनुरूपं हि पापस्य प्रायश्चित्तमुदाहृतम्। महापातकवर्जं तु प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते॥
en: I have now described what the expiations of the sins are. There is expiation for every sin except those that are (highly heinous.)

sa: महात्मना भगवता रामेण यदुपुङ्गव। कथमुत्सादितं क्षत्रं कथं वृद्धिमुपागतम्॥
en: How, O best of the Yadus, was the Kshatriya order exterminated by the illustrious and great Rama, and how did it again grow?

sa: किं वा तूष्णीं ध्यायसे संजयत्वं न मे राजन् वाचमिमां शृणोषि। न चेन्मोघं विप्रलप्तं ममेदं पथ्यं मुमूर्षोरिव सुप्रयुक्तम्॥
en: What are you, O Srinjaya, thinking of silently? It seems, O king, that you do not pay heed to these words of mine. If you have not heard them, then this discourse of mine has been fruitless like medicine or diet to a person on the point of death.'

sa: तान् सुपर्णाश्च गृध्राश्च कर्षयन्त्यसृगुक्षिताः। विगृह्य चरणैर्गध्रा भक्षयन्ति सहस्रशः॥
en: Dreadful vultures and thousands of others birds, are dragging those bodies stained with blood and seizing them by their armour, are devouring them.

sa: जम्बूद्वीपो महाराज नानाजनपदैर्युतः। त्वया पुरुषशार्दूल दण्डेन मृदितः प्रभो॥
en: (Formerly), O powerful one, you had, O king, governed with might, the region called Jaimbu, O foremost of men, abounding with populous districts!

sa: बलं चातिबलं चैव महावक्त्रौ महाबलौ॥ प्रददौ कार्तिकेयाय वायुर्भरतसत्तम।
en: Vayu gave him, O best of the Bharatas, two companions, viz., Vala and Atibala, possessed of great inight and very an large mouths.

sa: सर्वेषां कृतवैराणामविश्वासः सुखोदयः। एकान्ततो न विश्वासः कार्यो विश्वासघातकैः॥
en: Amongst imn who have injured one another, distrust would yield happiness. One who has betrayed confidence should never be trusted in the least.

sa: पतिव्रता भागा समानव्रतचारिणी। उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता सततं सत्यवादिनी॥
en: Devoted to her lord, that highly blessed lady always practised high vows. Practising the severest penances, she was always truthful in her speech.

sa: एवं सिसृक्षुर्भूतानि ददर्श प्रथमं विभुः। पितामहोऽब्रवीच्चैनं भूतानि सृज मा चिरम्॥ हरिकेशस्तथेत्युक्त्वा भूतानां दोषदर्शिवान्। दीर्घकालं तपस्तेपे मग्नोऽम्भसि महातपाः॥
en: The powerful Grandfather, desirous of creating living animals saw Rudra; and the Grandfather asked him, saying,-Create living creatures immediately.—Thus addressed the twany haired Rudra said,-So be it!-and plunged himself into the water and practised austerities for a long time, because he was sensible of the defects of living creatures.

sa: वैद्याश्चाप्यातुराः सन्ति बलवन्तश्च दुर्बलाः। श्रीमन्तचापरे षण्ढा विचित्रः कालपर्ययः॥
en: Physicians even fall ill. The strong become weak. The rich man lose all and become poor. The course of Time is highly wonderful.

sa: दृश्यते हि युवैवेह विनश्यन्वसुमानरः। दरिद्रश्च परिक्लिष्टः शतवर्षो जरान्वितः॥
en: It is seen that a rich man dies in youth; while a poor man lives on suffering from decrepitude, for a hundred years.

sa: चारमन्त्रविधानेषु कोशसंनिचयेषु च। नित्ययुक्ता महाबाहो वर्धन्ते सर्वतो गणाः॥
en: By always engaging spies and concerting measures of policy, and filling up their treasuries, the aristocracy, O you of mighty arms, grow prosperous.

sa: तस्मिंस्तेजसि याते तु तादृगरूपस्ततोऽपरः॥ शरीरानिःसृतस्तस्य को भवानिति चाब्रवीत्।
en: After the disappearance of that form, another of similar form issued out of Prahlada's body. The Daitya king addressing it, said,-Who are you?

sa: क्रियाभ्युपायैर्निहतौ मया राजन् पुरातनौ॥ तारकाश्च महादैत्यो विप्रचित्तिश्च वीर्यवान्।
en: Those two highly energetic and ancient Daityas, viz., Taraka and Viprachitti were, in ancient time, O king, slain by the help of illusion.

sa: तथा त्वमप्यच्युत मुञ्च शोर्क मुत्तिष्ठ शक्रोपम हर्षमेहि। क्षात्रेण धर्मेण मही जिता ते तां भुक्ष्व कुन्तीसुत मावमंस्था॥
en: O you of unfading glory, cast off your sorrow and rise up. You are equal to Shakra himself. Cheer up your heart. The Earth has been conquered by you by means of Kshatriya duties. Enjoy here, O son of Kunti, and do not disobey my words?"

sa: योऽत्यन्ताचरितां वृत्तिं क्षत्रियो नानुवर्तते। जितानामजितानां च क्षत्रधर्मादपैति सः॥
en: That Kshatriya, who does not follow the conduct observed from days of yore by other Kshatriyas conquered or unconquered, deviates from Kshatriyas duties.

sa: सुबलस्य हते पुत्रे सवाजिरथकुञ्जरे। महावनमिव च्छिन्नमभवत् तावकं बलम्॥
en: Upon the death of Subala's on along with horse, cars and elephants, your army looked like a large forest divested by a storm.

sa: धर्मराजपुरोगास्तु भीमसेनमुखा रथाः। न जहुः समरे शूरं शल्यमाहवशोभिनम्॥
en: Those amongst thein that were led by Bhimasena and king Yudhishthira did not fly away from the brave Shalya the ornament of battle.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य मुनयस्ते विधानतः॥ तस्माद् वेदाननुप्राप्य पुनधर्मं प्रचक्रिरे।
en: Hearing these words of his, those ascetics duly became his disciples and learning again from him the Vedas began to practise their rites.

sa: स्वर्गे लोके महीयन्तमप्सरोभिः शचीपतिम्। ऋषयः पर्युपासन्ते देवाश्च विबुधेश्वरम्॥
en: The lord of Shachi is worshipped in the heaven by the Apsaras. The Rishis and the other gods all adore himn with respect.

sa: तमेवंवादिनं धीरं प्रत्यूचुस्ते दिवौकसः॥ नैवमित्येव शंसन्तो जैगीषव्यं महामुनिम्।
en: The inhabitants of heaven then said to Narada who has communicated such dangerous words. Do not say about the great ascetic Jaigishavya !

sa: न चापि शत्रवस्तेषामृद्ध्यन्ते राज्ञि पाण्डवाः। शृणु यत् कृतमस्माभिरश्वत्थामपुरोगमैः॥
en: Their enemies, O queen viz., the Pandavas, too, have not been more fortunate. Hear, what we, headed by Ashvatthaman, have done to them.

sa: तत औशनसे तीर्थे तस्योपस्पृशतस्तदा। तच्छिरश्चरणं मुक्त्वा पपातान्तर्जले तदा॥
en: Then repairing to that Ushanasa tirtha, that Brahmana bathed in its waters. Thereat the Rakshasa's head, leaving the thigh, dropped into the water.

sa: दिष्ट्या त्वामिह संग्रामादस्माद् वीरक्षयात् पुरम्॥ समागतमपश्याम ांशुमन्तमिव प्रजाः।
en: By good luck we see you alive in this terrible battle in which heroes have been killed like creatures beholding the blazing sun.

sa: सह सात्यकिना शौरिरर्जुनस्य निवेशनम्। विवेश पुरुषव्याघ्रो व्याघ्रो गिरिगुहामिव॥
en: Like a tiger entering his cave in the hills that foremost of men, viz., Krishna, accompanied by Satyaki, entered the palace of Arjuna.

sa: तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ मण्डलानि विचेरतुः। आवर्तितौ गदाहस्तौ मद्रराजवृकोदरौ॥
en: Those two varriors Vrikodara and the king of the Madras, roaring the bulls, moved about in circles, frequently leaping up in the air.

sa: प्रकीर्य केशान् सुशुभान् भूषणान्यवमुच्य च। एकवस्त्रधरा नार्यः परिपेतुरनाथवत्॥
en: With their beautiful dishevelled hairs, and their ornaments thrown off, those ladies, each clad in a single piece of cloth, proceeded most sorrowfully.

sa: इमं च राजशार्दूल भूतग्रामं चतुर्विधम्। चक्षुर्दिव्यं समाश्रित्य द्रक्ष्यस्यमितविक्रम॥
en: O foremost of kings, acquiring choice vision, you will, O you of incomparable prowess, succeed in seeing the four orders of created things.

sa: तथाप्येते महाराज रथिनो नृपसत्तम। अक्षौहिणीनां सर्वासां समेतानां जनेश्वर॥
en: These three car-warriors, are all that survive, O best of kings, of all the Akshauhinis collected on your side, O ruler of men!
